````csharp
  1: using System;
  2: using System.Collections.Generic;
  3: using System.Linq;
  4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  5: using FluentValidation;
  6: 
  7: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.Event.Validators;
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13: public class CreateEventWithSessionsDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateEventWithSessionsDto>
 14: {
 15:     private readonly IAudienceAgeRepository _audienceAgeRepository;
 16:     private readonly IAudienceGenderRepository _audienceGenderRepository;
 17:     private readonly IEventTypeRepository _eventTypeRepository;
 18:     private readonly IOrganizationRepository _organizationRepository;
 19:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
 20:     private readonly ILocationRepository _locationRepository;
 21:     private readonly IRegistrationModeRepository _registrationModeRepository;
 22:     private readonly ILanguageRepository _languageRepository;
 23: 
 24:     public CreateEventWithSessionsDtoValidator(
 25:         IAudienceAgeRepository audienceAgeRepository,
 26:         IAudienceGenderRepository audienceGenderRepository,
 27:         IEventTypeRepository eventTypeRepository,
 28:         IOrganizationRepository organizationRepository,
 29:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository,
 30:         ILocationRepository locationRepository,
 31:         IRegistrationModeRepository registrationModeRepository,
 32:         ILanguageRepository languageRepository)
 33:     {
 34:         _audienceAgeRepository = audienceAgeRepository;
 35:         _audienceGenderRepository = audienceGenderRepository;
 36:         _eventTypeRepository = eventTypeRepository;
 37:         _organizationRepository = organizationRepository;
 38:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
 39:         _locationRepository = locationRepository;
 40:         _registrationModeRepository = registrationModeRepository;
 41:         _languageRepository = languageRepository;
 42: 
 43: 
 44: 
 45:         RuleFor(p => p.Title)
 46:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
 47:             .NotNull()
 48:             .MaximumLength(200).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 200 characters.");
 49: 
 50:         RuleFor(p => p.Description)
 51:             .MaximumLength(5000)
 52:             .When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.Description))
 53:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 5000 characters.");
 54: 
 55:         RuleFor(p => p.Slug)
 56:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
 57: 
 58:         RuleFor(p => p.EventTypeId)
 59:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
 60:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 61:             {
 62:                 var exists = await _eventTypeRepository.Exists(id);
 63:                 return exists;
 64:             }).WithMessage("Event type does not exist.");
 65: 
 66:         RuleFor(p => p.AudienceGenderId)
 67:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
 68:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 69:             {
 70:                 var exists = await _audienceGenderRepository.Exists(id);
 71:                 return exists;
 72:             }).WithMessage("Audience gender does not exist.");
 73: 
 74:         RuleFor(p => p.AudienceAgeId)
 75:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
 76:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 77:             {
 78:                 var exists = await _audienceAgeRepository.Exists(id);
 79:                 return exists;
 80:             }).WithMessage("Audience age does not exist.");
 81: 
 82:         RuleFor(p => p.OrganizationId)
 83:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 84:             {
 85:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
 86:                 return await _organizationRepository.Exists(id.Value);
 87:             })
 88:             .When(p => p.OrganizationId.HasValue)
 89:             .WithMessage("Organization does not exist.");
 90: 
 91:         RuleFor(p => p.Price)
 92:             .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0)
 93:             .When(p => p.Price.HasValue)
 94:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be greater than or equal to 0.");
 95: 
 96:         RuleFor(p => p.CurrencyCode)
 97:             .MaximumLength(3)
 98:             .When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.CurrencyCode))
 99:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be a valid 3-letter currency code.");
100: 
101:         RuleFor(p => p.FeaturedImageId)
102:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
103:             {
104:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
105:                 return await _storageObjectRepository.Exists(id.Value);
106:             })
107:             .When(p => p.FeaturedImageId.HasValue)
108:             .WithMessage("Featured image does not exist.");
109: 
110:         RuleFor(p => p.ExternalRegistrationUrl)
111:             .MaximumLength(500)
112:             .When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.ExternalRegistrationUrl))
113:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
114: 
115:         RuleFor(p => p.Timezone)
116:             .MaximumLength(100)
117:             .When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.Timezone))
118:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 100 characters.");
119: 
120:         RuleFor(p => p.EventUrl)
121:             .MaximumLength(500)
122:             .When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.EventUrl))
123:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
124: 
125: 
126: 
127:         RuleFor(p => p.Sessions)
128:             .NotNull().WithMessage("Sessions are required.")
129:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("At least one session is required.");
130: 
131:         RuleForEach(p => p.Sessions)
132:             .ChildRules(session =>
133:             {
134:                 session.RuleFor(s => s.Title)
135:                     .MaximumLength(500)
136:                     .When(s => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(s.Title))
137:                     .WithMessage("Session title must not exceed 500 characters.");
138: 
139:                 session.RuleFor(s => s.Description)
140:                     .MaximumLength(5000)
141:                     .When(s => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(s.Description))
142:                     .WithMessage("Session description must not exceed 5000 characters.");
143: 
144:                 session.RuleFor(s => s.StartTime)
145:                     .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Session start time is required.");
146: 
147:                 session.RuleFor(s => s.EndTime)
148:                     .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Session end time is required.")
149:                     .GreaterThan(s => s.StartTime)
150:                     .WithMessage("Session end time must be after start time.");
151: 
152:                 session.RuleFor(s => s.MaxAudienceAttendees)
153:                     .GreaterThan(0)
154:                     .When(s => s.MaxAudienceAttendees.HasValue)
155:                     .WithMessage("Maximum audience attendees must be greater than 0.");
156:             });
157: 
158: 
159:         RuleFor(p => p.Sessions)
160:             .MustAsync(async (sessions, cancellation) =>
161:             {
162:                 foreach (var session in sessions.Where(s => s.LocationId.HasValue))
163:                 {
164:                     var exists = await _locationRepository.Exists(session.LocationId!.Value);
165:                     if (!exists) return false;
166:                 }
167:                 return true;
168:             })
169:             .WithMessage("One or more session locations do not exist.");
170: 
171: 
172:         RuleFor(p => p.Sessions)
173:             .MustAsync(async (sessions, cancellation) =>
174:             {
175:                 foreach (var session in sessions.Where(s => s.RegistrationModeId.HasValue))
176:                 {
177:                     var exists = await _registrationModeRepository.Exists(session.RegistrationModeId!.Value);
178:                     if (!exists) return false;
179:                 }
180:                 return true;
181:             })
182:             .WithMessage("One or more session registration modes do not exist.");
183: 
184: 
185:         RuleFor(p => p.Sessions)
186:             .MustAsync(async (sessions, cancellation) =>
187:             {
188:                 foreach (var session in sessions)
189:                 {
190:                     foreach (var languageId in session.LanguageIds)
191:                     {
192:                         var exists = await _languageRepository.Exists(languageId);
193:                         if (!exists) return false;
194:                     }
195:                 }
196:                 return true;
197:             })
198:             .WithMessage("One or more session languages do not exist.");
199:     }
200: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/EventAspects/Validators/CreateUpdateTechAspectDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.EventAspects.Validators;
 2: 
 3: using System;
 4: using FluentValidation;
 5: 
 6: 
 7: 
 8: 
 9: public class CreateUpdateTechAspectDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateUpdateTechAspectDto>
10: {
11:     public CreateUpdateTechAspectDtoValidator()
12:     {
13: 
14:         RuleFor(x => x.GithubRepoUrl)
15:             .MaximumLength(500)
16:             .Must(url => string.IsNullOrEmpty(url) || Uri.TryCreate(url, UriKind.Absolute, out var result) &&
17:                         (result.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp || result.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps))
18:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.GithubRepoUrl))
19:             .WithMessage("GitHub repository URL must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL.");
20: 
21: 
22:         RuleFor(x => x.HackathonTrack)
23:             .MaximumLength(200)
24:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.HackathonTrack));
25: 
26: 
27:         RuleFor(x => x.SkillLevel)
28:             .IsInEnum()
29:             .WithMessage("Invalid skill level.");
30: 
31: 
32:         RuleFor(x => x.TechStackTags)
33:             .MaximumLength(1000)
34:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.TechStackTags));
35: 
36: 
37:         RuleFor(x => x.MaxTeamSize)
38:             .InclusiveBetween(1, 100)
39:             .When(x => x.MaxTeamSize.HasValue)
40:             .WithMessage("Max team size must be between 1 and 100.");
41: 
42: 
43:         RuleFor(x => x.PrizePool)
44:             .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0)
45:             .When(x => x.PrizePool.HasValue)
46:             .WithMessage("Prize pool cannot be negative.");
47: 
48: 
49:         RuleFor(x => x.PrizeCurrencyCode)
50:             .NotEmpty()
51:             .When(x => x.PrizePool.HasValue && x.PrizePool > 0)
52:             .WithMessage("Currency code is required when prize pool is specified.");
53: 
54: 
55:         RuleFor(x => x.PrizeCurrencyCode)
56:             .Length(3)
57:             .Matches("^[A-Z]{3}$")
58:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.PrizeCurrencyCode))
59:             .WithMessage("Currency code must be a 3-letter ISO code (e.g., USD, EUR).");
60:     }
61: }
````

````csharp
 1: using System;
````

````csharp
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using FluentValidation;
 6: 
 7: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.EventCategories.Validators
 8: {
 9:     public class CreateEventCategoriesDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateEventCategoriesDto>
10:     {
11:         private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
12:         private readonly ICategoryRepository _categoryRepository;
13:         private readonly IEventCategoriesRepository _eventCategoriesRepository;
14: 
15:         public CreateEventCategoriesDtoValidator(
16:             IEventRepository eventRepository,
17:             ICategoryRepository categoryRepository,
18:             IEventCategoriesRepository eventCategoriesRepository)
19:         {
20:             _eventRepository = eventRepository;
21:             _categoryRepository = categoryRepository;
22:             _eventCategoriesRepository = eventCategoriesRepository;
23: 
24:             RuleFor(x => x.EventId)
25:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
26:                 .MustAsync(EventExists)
27:                 .WithMessage("{PropertyName} not found");
28: 
29:             RuleFor(x => x.CategoryId)
30:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
31:                 .MustAsync(CategoryExists)
32:                 .WithMessage("{PropertyName} not found");
33: 
34: 
35: 
36: 
37:             RuleFor(x => x)
38:                 .MustAsync(EventCategoryNotExist)
39:                 .WithMessage("This Category is already assigned to this Event");
40:         }
41: 
42:         private async Task<bool> EventExists(Guid eventId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
43:         {
44:             return await _eventRepository.Exists(eventId);
45:         }
46: 
47:         private async Task<bool> CategoryExists(Guid categoryId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
48:         {
49:             return await _categoryRepository.Exists(categoryId);
50:         }
51: 
52:         private async Task<bool> EventCategoryNotExist(CreateEventCategoriesDto dto, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
53:         {
54:             return !await _eventCategoriesRepository.Exists(dto.EventId, dto.CategoryId);
55:         }
56:     }
57: }
````

````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Threading;
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using FluentValidation;
 6: 
 7: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.EventRegistration.Validators
 8: {
 9:     public class CreateEventRegistrationDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateEventRegistrationDto>
10:     {
11:         private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
12:         private readonly IEventSessionRepository _eventSessionRepository;
13:         private readonly IApprovalStatusRepository _approvalStatusRepository;
14:         private readonly IEventRegistrationRepository _eventRegistrationRepository;
15: 
16:         public CreateEventRegistrationDtoValidator(
17:             IUserRepository userRepository,
18:             IEventSessionRepository eventSessionRepository,
19:             IApprovalStatusRepository approvalStatusRepository,
20:             IEventRegistrationRepository eventRegistrationRepository)
21:         {
22:             _userRepository = userRepository;
23:             _eventSessionRepository = eventSessionRepository;
24:             _approvalStatusRepository = approvalStatusRepository;
25:             _eventRegistrationRepository = eventRegistrationRepository;
26: 
27:             RuleFor(x => x.UserId)
28:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
29:                 .MustAsync(UserExists)
30:                 .WithMessage("{PropertyName} not found");
31: 
32:             RuleFor(x => x.EventSessionId)
33:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
34:                 .MustAsync(EventSessionExists)
35:                 .WithMessage("{PropertyName} not found");
36: 
37:             RuleFor(x => x.ApprovalStatusId)
38:                 .MustAsync(ApprovalStatusExists)
39:                 .When(x => x.ApprovalStatusId.HasValue)
40:                 .WithMessage("{PropertyName} not found");
41: 
42: 
43: 
44: 
45:             RuleFor(x => x)
46:                 .MustAsync(UserNotAlreadyRegistered)
47:                 .WithMessage("User is already registered for this Event Session");
48:         }
49: 
50:         private async Task<bool> UserExists(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
51:         {
52:             return await _userRepository.Exists(userId);
53:         }
54: 
55:         private async Task<bool> EventSessionExists(Guid eventSessionId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
56:         {
57:             return await _eventSessionRepository.Exists(eventSessionId);
58:         }
59: 
60:         private async Task<bool> ApprovalStatusExists(int? approvalStatusId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
61:         {
62:             if (!approvalStatusId.HasValue) return true;
63:             return await _approvalStatusRepository.Exists(approvalStatusId.Value);
64:         }
65: 
66:         private async Task<bool> UserNotAlreadyRegistered(CreateEventRegistrationDto dto, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
67:         {
68:             return !await _eventRegistrationRepository.IsUserRegisteredForSession(dto.UserId, dto.EventSessionId);
69:         }
````

````csharp
33: 
34:             RuleFor(p => p.Description)

36:

38:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.");
39: 
40:             RuleFor(p => p.EndTime)
41:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
42:                 .GreaterThan(p => p.StartTime).WithMessage("EndTime must be after StartTime.");
43: 
44:             RuleFor(p => p.LocationId)
45:                 .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
46:                 {
47:                     if (!id.HasValue) return true;
48:                     var exists = await _locationRepository.Exists(id.Value);
49:                     return exists;
50:                 }).WithMessage("Location does not exist.");
````

````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Threading;
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using FluentValidation;
 6: 
 7: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.EventTags.Validators
 8: {
 9:     public class CreateEventTagsDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateEventTagsDto>
10:     {
11:         private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
12:         private readonly ITagRepository _tagRepository;
13:         private readonly IEventTagsRepository _eventTagsRepository;
14: 
15:         public CreateEventTagsDtoValidator(
16:             IEventRepository eventRepository,
17:             ITagRepository tagRepository,
18:             IEventTagsRepository eventTagsRepository)
19:         {
20:             _eventRepository = eventRepository;
21:             _tagRepository = tagRepository;
22:             _eventTagsRepository = eventTagsRepository;
23: 
24:             RuleFor(x => x.EventId)
25:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
26:                 .MustAsync(EventExists)
27:                 .WithMessage("{PropertyName} not found");
28: 
29:             RuleFor(x => x.TagId)
30:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
31:                 .MustAsync(TagExists)
32:                 .WithMessage("{PropertyName} not found");
33: 
34: 
35: 
36: 
37:             RuleFor(x => x)
38:                 .MustAsync(EventTagNotExist)
39:                 .WithMessage("This Tag is already assigned to this Event");
40:         }
41: 
42:         private async Task<bool> EventExists(Guid eventId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
43:         {
44:             return await _eventRepository.Exists(eventId);
45:         }
46: 
47:         private async Task<bool> TagExists(Guid tagId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
48:         {
49:             return await _tagRepository.Exists(tagId);
50:         }
51: 
52:         private async Task<bool> EventTagNotExist(CreateEventTagsDto dto, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
53:         {
54:             return !await _eventTagsRepository.Exists(dto.EventId, dto.TagId);
55:         }
56:     }
57: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/IndexedDid/Validators/CreateIndexedDidDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: using FluentValidation;
 2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 3: 
 4: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.IndexedDid.Validators
 5: {
 6:     public class CreateIndexedDidDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateIndexedDidDto>
 7:     {
 8:         public CreateIndexedDidDtoValidator()
 9:         {
10:             RuleFor(x => x.Did)
11:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Did is required")
12:                 .MaximumLength(255).WithMessage("Did must not exceed 255 characters")
13:                 .Must(BeValidDidFormat).WithMessage("Did must be in valid format (did:plc:xxx or did:web:xxx)");
14: 
15:             RuleFor(x => x.PdsHost)
16:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("PDS host is required")
17:                 .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("PDS host must not exceed 500 characters");
18: 
19:             RuleFor(x => x.Handle)
20:                 .MaximumLength(255).WithMessage("Handle must not exceed 255 characters");
21: 
22:             RuleFor(x => x.SigningKey)
23:                 .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Signing key must not exceed 500 characters");
24: 
25:             RuleFor(x => x.LastIndexedAt)
26:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Last indexed at is required");
27:         }
28: 
29:         private bool BeValidDidFormat(string did)
30:         {
31:             if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(did)) return false;
32:             return did.StartsWith("did:plc:") || did.StartsWith("did:web:");
33:         }
34:     }
35: }
````

````csharp
13: 
14:             RuleFor(p => p.Address)

22:                 .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
23: 
24:             RuleFor(p => p.Country)
25:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")

27:                 .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
28:

30:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")

45: 
46: 
47:
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/StorageObject/Validators/CreateStorageObjectDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Threading;
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using FluentValidation;
 6: 
 7: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.StorageObject.Validators
 8: {
 9:     public class CreateStorageObjectDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateStorageObjectDto>
10:     {
11:         private readonly IFileTypeRepository _fileTypeRepository;
12:         private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
13: 
14:         public CreateStorageObjectDtoValidator(
15:             IFileTypeRepository fileTypeRepository,
16:             IActorRepository actorRepository)
17:         {
18:             _fileTypeRepository = fileTypeRepository;
19:             _actorRepository = actorRepository;
20: 
21:             RuleFor(x => x.FileTypeId)
22:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
23:                 .MustAsync(FileTypeExists)
24:                 .WithMessage("{PropertyName} not found");
25: 
26:             RuleFor(x => x.Uri)
27:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
28:                 .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters");
29: 
30:             RuleFor(x => x.FullName)
31:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
32:                 .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters");
33: 
34:             RuleFor(x => x.Extension)
35:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
36:                 .MaximumLength(50).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 50 characters");
37: 
38:             RuleFor(x => x.Size)
39:                 .GreaterThan(0).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be greater than 0");
40: 
41:             RuleFor(x => x.ActorId)
42:                 .MustAsync(ActorExists)
43:                 .When(x => x.ActorId.HasValue)
44:                 .WithMessage("{PropertyName} not found");
45:         }
46: 
47:         private async Task<bool> FileTypeExists(int fileTypeId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
48:         {
49:             return await _fileTypeRepository.Exists(fileTypeId);
50:         }
51: 
52:         private async Task<bool> ActorExists(Guid? actorId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
53:         {
54:             if (!actorId.HasValue) return true;
55:             return await _actorRepository.Exists(actorId.Value);
56:         }
57:     }
58: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/StorageObject/Validators/UploadRequestDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: using FluentValidation;
 2: 
 3: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.StorageObject.Validators
 4: {
 5:     public class UploadRequestDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<UploadRequestDto>
 6:     {
 7:         public UploadRequestDtoValidator()
 8:         {
 9:             RuleFor(x => x.FileName)
10:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
11:                 .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters");
12: 
13:             RuleFor(x => x.ContentType)
14:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required")
15:                 .MaximumLength(100).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 100 characters")
16:                 .Must(BeValidContentType).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be a valid MIME type");
17:         }
18: 
19:         private bool BeValidContentType(string contentType)
20:         {
21:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(contentType)) return false;
22: 
23:             return contentType.Contains("/") && contentType.Split('/').Length == 2;
24:         }
25:     }
26: }
````

````csharp
 1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 2: using FluentValidation;
 3: 
 4: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.TagTypeTags.Validators
 5: {
 6:     public class CreateTagTypeTagsDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateTagTypeTagsDto>
 7:     {
 8:         private readonly ITagRepository _tagRepository;
 9:         private readonly ITagTypeRepository _tagTypeRepository;
10:         private readonly ITagTypeTagsRepository _tagTypeTagsRepository;
11: 
12:         public CreateTagTypeTagsDtoValidator(
13:             ITagRepository tagRepository,
14:             ITagTypeRepository tagTypeRepository,
15:             ITagTypeTagsRepository tagTypeTagsRepository)
16:         {
17:             _tagRepository = tagRepository;
18:             _tagTypeRepository = tagTypeRepository;
19:             _tagTypeTagsRepository = tagTypeTagsRepository;
20: 
21:             RuleFor(x => x.TagId)
22:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Tag is required")
23:                 .MustAsync(TagExists)
24:                 .WithMessage("Tag not found");
25: 
26:             RuleFor(x => x.TagTypeId)
27:                 .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Tag Type is required")
28:                 .MustAsync(TagTypeExists)
29:                 .WithMessage("Tag Type not found");
30: 
31:             RuleFor(x => x)
32:                 .MustAsync(TagTypeTagNotExist)
33:                 .WithMessage("This Tag is already assigned to this Tag Type");
34: 
35: 
36: 
37:         }
38: 
39:         private async Task<bool> TagExists(Guid tagId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
40:         {
41:             return await _tagRepository.Exists(tagId);
42:         }
43: 
44:         private async Task<bool> TagTypeExists(int tagTypeId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
45:         {
46:             return await _tagTypeRepository.Exists(tagTypeId);
47:         }
48: 
49:         private async Task<bool> TagTypeTagNotExist(CreateTagTypeTagsDto dto, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
50:         {
51:             return !await _tagTypeTagsRepository.Exists(dto.TagId, dto.TagTypeId);
52:         }
53:     }
54: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/ActorKeyStores/Handlers/Commands/CreateActorKeyStoreCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using AutoMapper;
 3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using Explore.Application.DTOs.ActorKeyStore.Validators;
 6: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 7: using Explore.Domain;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.ActorKeyStores.Requests.Commands;
 9: using FluentValidation;
10: 
11: namespace Explore.Application.Features.ActorKeyStores.Handlers.Commands
12: {
13:     public class CreateActorKeyStoreCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateActorKeyStoreCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
14:     {
15:         private readonly IActorKeyStoreRepository _actorKeyStoreRepository;
16:         private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
17:         private readonly ITenantRepository _tenantRepository;
18:         private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
19:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
20: 
21:         public CreateActorKeyStoreCommandHandler(
22:             IActorKeyStoreRepository actorKeyStoreRepository,
23:             IActorRepository actorRepository,
24:             ITenantRepository tenantRepository,
25:             ITenantContext tenantContext,
26:             IMapper mapper)
27:         {
28:             _actorKeyStoreRepository = actorKeyStoreRepository;
29:             _actorRepository = actorRepository;
30:             _tenantRepository = tenantRepository;
31:             _tenantContext = tenantContext;
32:             _mapper = mapper;
33:         }
34: 
35:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateActorKeyStoreCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
36:         {
37:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
38: 
39:             var validator = new CreateActorKeyStoreDtoValidator(_actorRepository, _tenantRepository);
40:             var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.ActorKeyStoreDto);
41: 
42:             if (!validationResult.IsValid)
43:             {
44:                 response.Success = false;
45:                 response.Message = "Actor Key Store creation failed.";
46:                 response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
47:                 return response;
48:             }
49: 
50:             var keyStore = _mapper.Map<ActorKeyStore>(request.ActorKeyStoreDto);
51:             keyStore.CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
52: 
53: 
54:             keyStore.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
55: 
56:             keyStore = await _actorKeyStoreRepository.Create(keyStore);
57: 
58:             response.Success = true;
59:             response.Id = keyStore.Id;
60:             response.Message = "Actor Key Store created successfully.";
61: 
62:             return response;
63:         }
64:     }
65: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/ActorKeyStores/Handlers/Commands/UpdateActorKeyStoreCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using MediatR;
````
````csharp
 2: using AutoMapper;
 3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 4: using Explore.Application.DTOs.ActorKeyStore;
 5: using Explore.Application.DTOs.ActorKeyStore.Validators;
 6: using Explore.Application.Features.ActorKeyStores.Requests.Commands;
 7: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 8: using Explore.Domain;
 9: using FluentValidation;
10: 
11: namespace Explore.Application.Features.ActorKeyStores.Handlers.Commands
12: {
13:     public class UpdateActorKeyStoreCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateActorKeyStoreCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
14:     {
15:         private readonly IActorKeyStoreRepository _actorKeyStoreRepository;
16:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
17:         private readonly IValidator<UpdateActorKeyStoreDto> _validator;
18: 
19:         public UpdateActorKeyStoreCommandHandler(
20:             IActorKeyStoreRepository actorKeyStoreRepository,
21:             IMapper mapper,
22:             IValidator<UpdateActorKeyStoreDto> validator)
23:         {
24:             _actorKeyStoreRepository = actorKeyStoreRepository;
25:             _mapper = mapper;
26:             _validator = validator;
27:         }
28: 
29:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateActorKeyStoreCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
30:         {
31:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
32: 
33:             var validationResult = await _validator.ValidateAsync(request.ActorKeyStoreDto);
34: 
35:             if (!validationResult.IsValid)
36:             {
37:                 response.Success = false;
38:                 response.Message = "Actor Key Store update failed.";
39:                 response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
40:                 return response;
41:             }
42: 
43:             var existingKeyStore = await _actorKeyStoreRepository.GetById(request.ActorKeyStoreDto.Id);
44:             if (existingKeyStore == null)
45:             {
46:                 response.Success = false;
47:                 response.Message = "Actor Key Store not found.";
48:                 return response;
49:             }
50: 
51:             _mapper.Map(request.ActorKeyStoreDto, existingKeyStore);
52:             await _actorKeyStoreRepository.Update(existingKeyStore);
53: 
54:             response.Success = true;
55:             response.Id = existingKeyStore.Id;
56:             response.Message = "Actor Key Store updated successfully.";
57: 
58:             return response;
59:         }
60:     }
61: }
````

````csharp
20:     private readonly IOrganizationRepository _organizationRepository;

24:     public CreateActorCommandHandler(
25:         IActorRepository actorRepository,
26:         IActorTypeRepository actorTypeRepository,
27:         IDidCustodyTypeRepository didCustodyTypeRepository,
28:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository,
29:         ITenantRepository tenantRepository,
30:         IUserRepository userRepository,
31:         IOrganizationRepository organizationRepository,
32:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
33:         IMapper mapper)
34:     {
35:         _actorRepository = actorRepository;
36:         _actorTypeRepository = actorTypeRepository;
37:         _didCustodyTypeRepository = didCustodyTypeRepository;
38:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
39:         _tenantRepository = tenantRepository;
40:         _userRepository = userRepository;
41:         _organizationRepository = organizationRepository;
42:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
43:         _mapper = mapper;
44:     }
45: 
46:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateActorCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
47:     {
48:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
49: 
50:         var validator = new CreateActorDtoValidator(
51:             _actorTypeRepository,
52:             _didCustodyTypeRepository,
53:             _storageObjectRepository,
54:             _tenantRepository,
55:             _actorRepository,
56:             _userRepository,
57:             _organizationRepository);
58: 
59:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.ActorDto, cancellationToken);
60: 
61:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
62:         {
63:             response.Success = false;
64:             response.Message = "Actor creation failed.";
65:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
66:             return response;

75:

78:         response.Message = "Actor created successfully.";

80:         return response;
````

````csharp
21: {
22:     private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
23:     private readonly IEventIslamicAspectRepository _islamicAspectRepository;
24:     private readonly IMadhabRepository _madhabRepository;
25:     private readonly ILanguageRepository _languageRepository;
26:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
27:     private readonly ICurrentUserService _currentUserService;
28: 
29:     public UpsertEventIslamicAspectCommandHandler(
30:         IEventRepository eventRepository,
31:         IEventIslamicAspectRepository islamicAspectRepository,
32:         IMadhabRepository madhabRepository,
33:         ILanguageRepository languageRepository,
34:         IMapper mapper,
35:         ICurrentUserService currentUserService)
36:     {
37:         _eventRepository = eventRepository;
38:         _islamicAspectRepository = islamicAspectRepository;
39:         _madhabRepository = madhabRepository;
40:         _languageRepository = languageRepository;
41:         _mapper = mapper;
42:         _currentUserService = currentUserService;

48: 
49: 
50:         var eventExists = await _eventRepository.Exists(request.EventId);
51:         if (!eventExists)
52:         {
53:             response.Success = false;
54:             response.Message = "Event not found.";
55:             response.Errors = new List<string> { $"Event with ID {request.EventId} does not exist." };
56:             return response;
57:         }
58: 
59: 
60:         var validator = new CreateUpdateIslamicAspectDtoValidator(_madhabRepository, _languageRepository);
61:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.AspectDto, cancellationToken);
62: 
63:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
64:         {
65:             response.Success = false;
66:             response.Message = "Validation failed.";
67:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
68:             return response;
69:         }
70: 
71: 
72:         var aspect = _mapper.Map<EventIslamicAspect>(request.AspectDto);
73: 
74: 
75:         aspect.Id = request.EventId;
76: 
77: 
78:         aspect = await _islamicAspectRepository.Upsert(aspect);
79: 
80:         response.Success = true;
81:         response.Id = aspect.Id;
82:         response.Message = "Islamic aspect saved successfully.";
83: 
84:         return response;
85:     }
86: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/EventCategories/Handlers/Commands/CreateEventCategoriesCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 7: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 8: using Explore.Application.DTOs.EventCategories.Validators;
 9: using Explore.Application.Features.EventCategories.Requests.Commands;
10: using Explore.Application.Responses;
11: using MediatR;
12: 
13: namespace Explore.Application.Features.EventCategories.Handlers.Commands
14: {
15:     public class CreateEventCategoriesCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateEventCategoriesCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
16:     {
17:         private readonly IEventCategoriesRepository _eventCategoriesRepository;
18:         private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
19:         private readonly ICategoryRepository _categoryRepository;
20:         private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
21:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
22: 
23:         public CreateEventCategoriesCommandHandler(
24:             IEventCategoriesRepository eventCategoriesRepository,
25:             IEventRepository eventRepository,
26:             ICategoryRepository categoryRepository,
27:             ITenantContext tenantContext,
28:             IMapper mapper)
29:         {
30:             _eventCategoriesRepository = eventCategoriesRepository;
31:             _eventRepository = eventRepository;
32:             _categoryRepository = categoryRepository;
33:             _tenantContext = tenantContext;
34:             _mapper = mapper;
35:         }
36: 
37:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateEventCategoriesCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
38:         {
39:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
40: 
41:             var validator = new CreateEventCategoriesDtoValidator(_eventRepository, _categoryRepository, _eventCategoriesRepository);
42:             var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.EventCategoriesDto);
43: 
44:             if (!validationResult.IsValid)
45:             {
46:                 response.Success = false;
47:                 response.Message = "Event Category assignment failed.";
48:                 response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
49:                 return response;
50:             }
51: 
52:             var eventCategories = _mapper.Map<Domain.EventCategories>(request.EventCategoriesDto);
53: 
54: 
55:             eventCategories.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
56: 
57:             eventCategories = await _eventCategoriesRepository.Create(eventCategories);
58: 
59:             response.Success = true;
60:             response.Id = eventCategories.Id;
61:             response.Message = "Event Category assigned successfully.";
62: 
63:             return response;
64:         }
65:     }
66: }
````

````csharp
16:         private readonly IEventCategoriesRepository _eventCategoriesRepository;
17:         private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
18:         private readonly ICategoryRepository _categoryRepository;
19:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
20: 
21:         public UpdateEventCategoriesCommandHandler(
22:             IEventCategoriesRepository eventCategoriesRepository,
23:             IEventRepository eventRepository,
24:             ICategoryRepository categoryRepository,
25:             IMapper mapper)
26:         {
27:             _eventCategoriesRepository = eventCategoriesRepository;
28:             _eventRepository = eventRepository;
29:             _categoryRepository = categoryRepository;
30:             _mapper = mapper;
31:         }

33:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateEventCategoriesCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)

63:
````

````csharp
14: {
15:     public class CreateEventSessionLanguageCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateEventSessionLanguageCommand, BaseCommandResponse<int>>
16:     {
17:         private readonly IEventSessionLanguageRepository _repository;
18:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
19:         private readonly IEventSessionRepository _eventSessionRepository;
20:         private readonly ILanguageRepository _languageRepository;
21:         private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
22: 
23:         public CreateEventSessionLanguageCommandHandler(
24:             IEventSessionLanguageRepository repository,
25:             IMapper mapper,

28:             ITenantContext tenantContext)

33:             _languageRepository = languageRepository;
34:             _tenantContext = tenantContext;
35:         }
36: 
37:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<int>> Handle(CreateEventSessionLanguageCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
38:         {
39:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<int>();

46:                 response.Success = false;

49:                 return response;

53: 
54: 
55:             eventSessionLanguage.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
56: 
57:             eventSessionLanguage = await _repository.Create(eventSessionLanguage);
58: 
59:             response.Success = true;
60:             response.Id = eventSessionLanguage.Id;
61:             response.Message = "Event Session Language created successfully.";
62: 
63:             return response;
64:         }
65:     }
66: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/EventSessions/Handlers/Queries/GetEventSessionListRequestHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System.Collections.Generic;
 2: using System.Threading;
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: using AutoMapper;
 5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 6: using Explore.Application.DTOs.EventSession;
 7: using Explore.Application.Features.EventSessions.Requests.Queries;
 8: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 9: using MediatR;
10: 
11: namespace Explore.Application.Features.EventSessions.Handlers.Queries
12: {
13:     public class GetEventSessionListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetEventSessionListRequest, PaginatedResult<EventSessionListDto>>
14:     {
15:         private readonly IEventSessionRepository _eventSessionRepository;
16:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
17: 
18:         public GetEventSessionListRequestHandler(
19:             IEventSessionRepository eventSessionRepository,
20:             IMapper mapper)
21:         {
22:             _eventSessionRepository = eventSessionRepository;
23:             _mapper = mapper;
24:         }
25: 
26:         public async Task<PaginatedResult<EventSessionListDto>> Handle(GetEventSessionListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
27:         {
28:             var (pageNumber, pageSize) = PaginatedResult<EventSessionListDto>.NormalizeParameters(request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
29:             var (eventSessions, totalCount) = await _eventSessionRepository.GetSessionsWithDetailsPaged(pageNumber, pageSize);
30:             var dtos = _mapper.Map<List<EventSessionListDto>>(eventSessions);
31:             return PaginatedResult<EventSessionListDto>.Create(dtos, totalCount, pageNumber, pageSize);
32:         }
33:     }
34: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/EventSessionSpeakers/Handlers/Commands/CreateEventSessionSpeakerCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 7: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 8: using Explore.Application.DTOs.EventSessionSpeaker.Validators;
 9: using Explore.Application.Features.EventSessionSpeakers.Requests.Commands;
10: using Explore.Application.Responses;
11: using Explore.Domain;
12: using MediatR;
13: 
14: namespace Explore.Application.Features.EventSessionSpeakers.Handlers.Commands
15: {
16:     public class CreateEventSessionSpeakerCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateEventSessionSpeakerCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
17:     {
18:         private readonly IEventSessionSpeakerRepository _speakerRepository;
19:         private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
20:         private readonly IEventSessionRepository _eventSessionRepository;
21:         private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
22:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
23: 
24:         public CreateEventSessionSpeakerCommandHandler(
25:             IEventSessionSpeakerRepository speakerRepository,
26:             IActorRepository actorRepository,
27:             IEventSessionRepository eventSessionRepository,
28:             ITenantContext tenantContext,
29:             IMapper mapper)
30:         {
31:             _speakerRepository = speakerRepository;
32:             _actorRepository = actorRepository;
33:             _eventSessionRepository = eventSessionRepository;
34:             _tenantContext = tenantContext;
35:             _mapper = mapper;
36:         }
37: 
38:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateEventSessionSpeakerCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
39:         {
40:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
41: 
42:             var validator = new CreateEventSessionSpeakerDtoValidator(_actorRepository, _eventSessionRepository);
43:             var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.SpeakerDto);
44: 
45:             if (!validationResult.IsValid)
46:             {
47:                 response.Success = false;
48:                 response.Message = "Speaker assignment creation failed.";
49:                 response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
50:                 return response;
51:             }
52: 
53:             var speaker = _mapper.Map<EventSessionSpeaker>(request.SpeakerDto);
54: 
55: 
56:             speaker.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
57: 
58:             speaker = await _speakerRepository.Create(speaker);
59: 
60:             response.Success = true;
61:             response.Id = speaker.Id;
62:             response.Message = "Speaker assigned to session successfully.";
63: 
64:             return response;
65:         }
66:     }
67: }
````

````csharp
 1: using System.Threading;
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/EventSessionSpeakers/Handlers/Commands/UpdateEventSessionSpeakerCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.EventSessionSpeaker.Validators;

 9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
10: using MediatR;
11: 
12: namespace Explore.Application.Features.EventSessionSpeakers.Handlers.Commands
13: {
14:     public class UpdateEventSessionSpeakerCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateEventSessionSpeakerCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
15:     {
16:         private readonly IEventSessionSpeakerRepository _speakerRepository;
17:         private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
18:         private readonly IEventSessionRepository _eventSessionRepository;
19:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
20: 
21:         public UpdateEventSessionSpeakerCommandHandler(
22:             IEventSessionSpeakerRepository speakerRepository,
23:             IActorRepository actorRepository,
24:             IEventSessionRepository eventSessionRepository,
25:             IMapper mapper)
26:         {
27:             _speakerRepository = speakerRepository;
28:             _actorRepository = actorRepository;
29:             _eventSessionRepository = eventSessionRepository;
30:             _mapper = mapper;
31:         }
32: 
33:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateEventSessionSpeakerCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
34:         {
35:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
36: 
37:             var validator = new UpdateEventSessionSpeakerDtoValidator(_actorRepository, _eventSessionRepository);
38:             var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.SpeakerDto);
39: 
40:             if (!validationResult.IsValid)
41:             {
42:                 response.Success = false;
43:                 response.Message = "Speaker assignment update failed.";
44:                 response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
45:                 return response;
46:             }
47: 
48:             var speaker = await _speakerRepository.GetById(request.SpeakerDto.Id);
49: 
50:             if (speaker == null)
51:             {
52:                 response.Success = false;
53:                 response.Message = "Speaker assignment not found.";
54:                 return response;
55:             }
56: 
57:             _mapper.Map(request.SpeakerDto, speaker);
58: 
59:             await _speakerRepository.Update(speaker);
60: 
61:             response.Success = true;
62:             response.Id = speaker.Id;
63:             response.Message = "Speaker assignment updated successfully.";
64: 
65:             return response;
66:         }
67:     }
68: }
````

````csharp
 2: using System.Linq;

12: 
13: namespace Explore.Application.Features.EventTags.Handlers.Commands
14: {
15:     public class CreateEventTagsCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateEventTagsCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
16:     {
17:         private readonly IEventTagsRepository _eventTagsRepository;
18:         private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
19:         private readonly ITagRepository _tagRepository;
20:         private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
21:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
22: 
23:         public CreateEventTagsCommandHandler(
24:             IEventTagsRepository eventTagsRepository,
25:             IEventRepository eventRepository,
26:             ITagRepository tagRepository,
27:             ITenantContext tenantContext,
28:             IMapper mapper)
29:         {
30:             _eventTagsRepository = eventTagsRepository;
31:             _eventRepository = eventRepository;
32:             _tagRepository = tagRepository;
33:             _tenantContext = tenantContext;
34:             _mapper = mapper;
35:         }
36: 
37:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateEventTagsCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
38:         {
39:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
40: 
41:             var validator = new CreateEventTagsDtoValidator(_eventRepository, _tagRepository, _eventTagsRepository);
42:             var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.EventTagsDto);
43: 
44:             if (!validationResult.IsValid)
45:             {
46:                 response.Success = false;
47:                 response.Message = "Event Tag assignment failed.";
48:                 response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
49:                 return response;
50:             }
51: 
52:             var eventTags = _mapper.Map<Domain.EventTags>(request.EventTagsDto);
53: 
54: 
55:             eventTags.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
56: 
57:             eventTags = await _eventTagsRepository.Create(eventTags);
58: 
59:             response.Success = true;
60:             response.Id = eventTags.Id;
61:             response.Message = "Event Tag assigned successfully.";
62: 
63:             return response;
64:         }
65:     }
66: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Locations/Handlers/Commands/CreateLocationCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 7: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 8: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Location.Validators;
 9: using Explore.Application.Features.Locations.Requests.Commands;
10: using Explore.Application.Responses;
11: using Explore.Domain;
12: using MediatR;
13: 
14: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Locations.Handlers.Commands
15: {
16:     public class CreateLocationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateLocationCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
17:     {
18:         private readonly ILocationRepository _locationRepository;
19:         private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
20:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
21: 
22:         public CreateLocationCommandHandler(
23:             ILocationRepository locationRepository,
24:             ITenantContext tenantContext,
25:             IMapper mapper)
26:         {
27:             _locationRepository = locationRepository;
28:             _tenantContext = tenantContext;
29:             _mapper = mapper;
30:         }
31: 
32:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateLocationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
33:         {
34:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
35: 
36:             var validator = new CreateLocationDtoValidator();
37:             var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.LocationDto);
38: 
39:             if (!validationResult.IsValid)
40:             {
41:                 response.Success = false;
42:                 response.Message = "Location creation failed.";
43:                 response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
44:                 return response;
45:             }
46: 
47:             var location = _mapper.Map<Location>(request.LocationDto);
48: 
49: 
50:             location.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
51: 
52:             location = await _locationRepository.Create(location);
53: 
54:             response.Success = true;
55:             response.Id = location.Id;
56:             response.Message = "Location created successfully.";
57: 
58:             return response;
59:         }
60:     }
61: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Locations/Handlers/Commands/UpdateLocationCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
````
````csharp
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Location.Validators;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.Locations.Requests.Commands;
 9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
10: using Explore.Domain;
11: using MediatR;
12: 
13: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Locations.Handlers.Commands
14: {
15:     public class UpdateLocationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateLocationCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
16:     {
17:         private readonly ILocationRepository _locationRepository;
18:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
19: 
20:         public UpdateLocationCommandHandler(
21:             ILocationRepository locationRepository,
22:             IMapper mapper)
23:         {
24:             _locationRepository = locationRepository;
25:             _mapper = mapper;
26:         }
27: 
28:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateLocationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
29:         {
30:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
31: 
32:             var validator = new UpdateLocationDtoValidator();
33:             var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.LocationDto);
34: 
35:             if (!validationResult.IsValid)
36:             {
37:                 response.Success = false;
38:                 response.Message = "Location update failed.";
39:                 response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
40:                 return response;
41:             }
42: 
43:             var location = await _locationRepository.GetById(request.LocationDto.Id);
44: 
45:             if (location == null)
46:             {
47:                 response.Success = false;
48:                 response.Message = "Location not found.";
49:                 return response;
50:             }
51: 
52:             _mapper.Map(request.LocationDto, location);
53: 
54:             await _locationRepository.Update(location);
55: 
56:             response.Success = true;
57:             response.Id = location.Id;
58:             response.Message = "Location updated successfully.";
59: 
60:             return response;
61:         }
62:     }
63: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Locations/Handlers/Queries/GetLocationListRequestHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System.Collections.Generic;
 2: using System.Threading;
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: using AutoMapper;
 5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 6: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Location;
 7: using Explore.Application.Features.Locations.Requests.Queries;
 8: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 9: using MediatR;
10: 
11: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Locations.Handlers.Queries
12: {
13:     public class GetLocationListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetLocationListRequest, PaginatedResult<LocationListDto>>
14:     {
15:         private readonly ILocationRepository _locationRepository;
16:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
17: 
18:         public GetLocationListRequestHandler(
19:             ILocationRepository locationRepository,
20:             IMapper mapper)
21:         {
22:             _locationRepository = locationRepository;
23:             _mapper = mapper;
24:         }
25: 
26:         public async Task<PaginatedResult<LocationListDto>> Handle(GetLocationListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
27:         {
28:             var (pageNumber, pageSize) = PaginatedResult<LocationListDto>.NormalizeParameters(request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
29:             var (locations, totalCount) = await _locationRepository.GetLocationsWithDetailsPaged(pageNumber, pageSize);
30:             var dtos = _mapper.Map<List<LocationListDto>>(locations);
31:             return PaginatedResult<LocationListDto>.Create(dtos, totalCount, pageNumber, pageSize);
32:         }
33:     }
34: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/OrganizationMembers/Handlers/Commands/AcceptInvitationCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 2: using Explore.Application.Features.OrganizationMembers.Requests.Commands;
 3: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 4: using MediatR;
 5: using System;
 6: using System.Threading;
 7: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 8: 
 9: namespace Explore.Application.Features.OrganizationMembers.Handlers.Commands
10: {
11:     public class AcceptInvitationCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AcceptInvitationCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
12:     {
13:         private readonly IOrganizationMemberRepository _organizationMemberRepository;
14: 
15:         public AcceptInvitationCommandHandler(IOrganizationMemberRepository organizationMemberRepository)
16:         {
17:             _organizationMemberRepository = organizationMemberRepository;
18:         }
19: 
20:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(AcceptInvitationCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
21:         {
22:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
23:             var invitation = await _organizationMemberRepository.GetById(request.InvitationId);
24: 
25:             if (invitation == null)
26:             {
27:                 response.Success = false;
28:                 response.Message = "Invitation not found";
29:                 return response;
30:             }
31: 
32:             if (invitation.UserId != null)
33:             {
34:                 response.Success = false;
35:                 response.Message = "Invitation already accepted";
36:                 return response;
37:             }
38: 
39:             invitation.UserId = request.UserId;
40:             await _organizationMemberRepository.Update(invitation);
41: 
42:             response.Success = true;
43:             response.Message = "Invitation accepted";
44:             response.Id = invitation.Id;
45: 
46:             return response;
47:         }
48:     }
49: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/StorageObjects/Handlers/Commands/CreateStorageObjectCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using AutoMapper;
 3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using Explore.Application.DTOs.StorageObject;
 6: using Explore.Application.DTOs.StorageObject.Validators;
 7: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 8: using FluentValidation;
 9: using Explore.Application.Features.StorageObjects.Requests.Commands;
10: 
11: namespace Explore.Application.Features.StorageObjects.Handlers.Commands
12: {
13:     public class CreateStorageObjectCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateStorageObjectCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
14:     {
15:         private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
16:         private readonly IFileTypeRepository _fileTypeRepository;
17:         private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
18:         private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
19:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
20: 
21:         public CreateStorageObjectCommandHandler(
22:             IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository,
23:             IFileTypeRepository fileTypeRepository,
24:             IActorRepository actorRepository,
25:             ITenantContext tenantContext,
26:             IMapper mapper)
27:         {
28:             _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
29:             _fileTypeRepository = fileTypeRepository;
30:             _actorRepository = actorRepository;
31:             _tenantContext = tenantContext;
32:             _mapper = mapper;
33:         }
34: 
35:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateStorageObjectCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
36:         {
37:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
38: 
39: 
40:             var validator = new CreateStorageObjectDtoValidator(_fileTypeRepository, _actorRepository);
41:             var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.StorageObjectDto, cancellationToken);
42: 
43:             if (!validationResult.IsValid)
44:             {
45:                 response.Success = false;
46:                 response.Message = "Storage object creation failed.";
47:                 response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
48:                 return response;
49:             }
50: 
51: 
52:             var entity = _mapper.Map<Domain.StorageObject>(request.StorageObjectDto);
53:

55:             entity.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
56:
````

````csharp
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 5: using Explore.Application.DTOs.StorageObject;
````

````csharp
 9: 
10: namespace Explore.Application.Features.StorageObjects.Handlers.Queries;
11: 
12: 
13: 
14: 
15: public class GetPresignedDownloadUrlByKeyRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetPresignedDownloadUrlByKeyRequest, PresignedDownloadUrlResponseDto?>
16: {
17:     private readonly IObjectStorageService _objectStorageService;
18:     private readonly ILogger<GetPresignedDownloadUrlByKeyRequestHandler> _logger;
19: 
20:     public GetPresignedDownloadUrlByKeyRequestHandler(
21:         IObjectStorageService objectStorageService,
22:         ILogger<GetPresignedDownloadUrlByKeyRequestHandler> logger)
23:     {
24:         _objectStorageService = objectStorageService;
25:         _logger = logger;
26:     }
27: 
28:     public Task<PresignedDownloadUrlResponseDto?> Handle(GetPresignedDownloadUrlByKeyRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
29:     {
30:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.ObjectKey))
31:         {
32:             _logger.LogWarning("Object key cannot be empty");
33:             return Task.FromResult<PresignedDownloadUrlResponseDto?>(null);
34:         }
35: 
36:         try
37:         {
38:             var presignedUrl = _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(request.ObjectKey, request.ExpirationMinutes);
39: 
40:             var response = new PresignedDownloadUrlResponseDto
41:             {
42:                 PresignedUrl = presignedUrl,
43:                 ObjectKey = request.ObjectKey,
44:                 ExpiresInMinutes = request.ExpirationMinutes
45:             };
46: 
47:             return Task.FromResult<PresignedDownloadUrlResponseDto?>(response);
48:         }
49:         catch (Exception ex)
50:         {
51:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate presigned URL for object key: {ObjectKey}", request.ObjectKey);
52:             return Task.FromResult<PresignedDownloadUrlResponseDto?>(null);
53:         }
54:     }
55: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/StorageObjects/Handlers/Queries/GetPresignedDownloadUrlRequestHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Threading;
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 6: using Explore.Application.DTOs.StorageObject;
 7: using Explore.Application.Features.StorageObjects.Requests.Queries;
 8: using MediatR;
 9: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
10: 
11: namespace Explore.Application.Features.StorageObjects.Handlers.Queries;
12: 
13: 
14: 
15: 
16: public class GetPresignedDownloadUrlRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetPresignedDownloadUrlRequest, PresignedDownloadUrlResponseDto?>
17: {
18:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
19:     private readonly IObjectStorageService _objectStorageService;
20:     private readonly ILogger<GetPresignedDownloadUrlRequestHandler> _logger;
21: 
22:     public GetPresignedDownloadUrlRequestHandler(
23:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository,
24:         IObjectStorageService objectStorageService,
25:         ILogger<GetPresignedDownloadUrlRequestHandler> logger)
26:     {
27:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
28:         _objectStorageService = objectStorageService;
29:         _logger = logger;
30:     }
31: 
32:     public async Task<PresignedDownloadUrlResponseDto?> Handle(GetPresignedDownloadUrlRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
33:     {
34:         var storageObject = await _storageObjectRepository.GetById(request.Id);
35: 
36:         if (storageObject == null)
37:         {
38:             _logger.LogWarning("Storage object not found: {Id}", request.Id);
39:             return null;
40:         }
41: 
42:         var objectKey = ExtractObjectKeyFromUri(storageObject.Uri);
43: 
44:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(objectKey))
45:         {
46:             _logger.LogWarning("Could not extract object key from URI: {Uri}", storageObject.Uri);
47:             return null;
48:         }
49: 
50:         try
51:         {
52:             var presignedUrl = _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKey, request.ExpirationMinutes);
53: 
54:             return new PresignedDownloadUrlResponseDto
55:             {
56:                 PresignedUrl = presignedUrl,
57:                 ObjectKey = objectKey,
58:                 ExpiresInMinutes = request.ExpirationMinutes
59:             };
60:         }
61:         catch (Exception ex)
62:         {
63:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate presigned URL for storage object: {Id}", request.Id);
64:             return null;
65:         }
66:     }
67: 
68: 
69: 
70: 
71:     private static string? ExtractObjectKeyFromUri(string uri)
72:     {
73:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(uri))
74:             return null;
75: 
76: 
77:         if (!uri.StartsWith("http://") && !uri.StartsWith("https://"))
78:             return uri;
79: 
80:         try
81:         {
82:             var uriObj = new Uri(uri);
83: 
84:             var path = uriObj.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
85:             return string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) ? null : path;
86:         }
87:         catch
88:         {
89:             return null;
90:         }
91:     }
92: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Tags/Handlers/Commands/CreateTagCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 7: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 8: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Tag.Validators;
 9: using Explore.Application.Features.Tags.Requests.Commands;
10: using Explore.Application.Responses;
11: using Explore.Domain;
12: using MediatR;
13: 
14: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Tags.Handlers.Commands
15: {
16:     public class CreateTagCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateTagCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
17:     {
18:         private readonly ITagRepository _tagRepository;
19:         private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
20:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
21: 
22:         public CreateTagCommandHandler(
23:             ITagRepository tagRepository,
24:             ITenantContext tenantContext,
25:             IMapper mapper)
26:         {
27:             _tagRepository = tagRepository;
28:             _tenantContext = tenantContext;
29:             _mapper = mapper;
30:         }
31: 
32:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateTagCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
33:         {
34:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
35: 
36:             var validator = new CreateTagDtoValidator();
37:             var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.TagDto);
38: 
39:             if (!validationResult.IsValid)
40:             {
41:                 response.Success = false;
42:                 response.Message = "Tag creation failed.";
43:                 response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
44:                 return response;
45:             }
46: 
47:             var tag = _mapper.Map<Tag>(request.TagDto);
48: 
49: 
50:             tag.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
51: 
52:             tag = await _tagRepository.Create(tag);
53: 
54:             response.Success = true;
55:             response.Id = tag.Id;
56:             response.Message = "Tag created successfully.";
57: 
58:             return response;
59:         }
60:     }
61: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Tags/Handlers/Commands/UpdateTagCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Linq;
 3: using System.Threading;
 4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 5: using AutoMapper;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Tag.Validators;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.Tags.Requests.Commands;
 9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
10: using MediatR;
11: 
12: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Tags.Handlers.Commands
13: {
14:     public class UpdateTagCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateTagCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
15:     {
16:         private readonly ITagRepository _tagRepository;
17:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
18: 
19:         public UpdateTagCommandHandler(
20:             ITagRepository tagRepository,
21:             IMapper mapper)
22:         {
23:             _tagRepository = tagRepository;
24:             _mapper = mapper;
25:         }
26: 
27:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateTagCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
28:         {
29:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
30: 
31:             var validator = new UpdateTagDtoValidator();
32:             var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.TagDto);
33: 
34:             if (!validationResult.IsValid)
35:             {
36:                 response.Success = false;
37:                 response.Message = "Tag update failed.";
38:                 response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
39:                 return response;
40:             }
41: 
42:             var tag = await _tagRepository.GetById(request.TagDto.Id);
43: 
44:             if (tag == null)
45:             {
46:                 response.Success = false;
47:                 response.Message = "Tag not found.";
48:                 return response;
49:             }
50: 
51:             _mapper.Map(request.TagDto, tag);
52: 
53:             await _tagRepository.Update(tag);
54: 
55:             response.Success = true;
56:             response.Id = tag.Id;
57:             response.Message = "Tag updated successfully.";
58: 
59:             return response;
60:         }
61:     }
62: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Tags/Handlers/Queries/GetTagListRequestHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System.Collections.Generic;
 2: using System.Threading;
 3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 4: using AutoMapper;
 5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 6: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Tag;
 7: using Explore.Application.Features.Tags.Requests.Queries;
 8: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 9: using MediatR;
10: 
11: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Tags.Handlers.Queries
12: {
13:     public class GetTagListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetTagListRequest, PaginatedResult<TagListDto>>
14:     {
15:         private readonly ITagRepository _tagRepository;
16:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
17: 
18:         public GetTagListRequestHandler(
19:             ITagRepository tagRepository,
20:             IMapper mapper)
21:         {
22:             _tagRepository = tagRepository;
23:             _mapper = mapper;
24:         }
25: 
26:         public async Task<PaginatedResult<TagListDto>> Handle(GetTagListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
27:         {
28:             var (pageNumber, pageSize) = PaginatedResult<TagListDto>.NormalizeParameters(request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
29:             var (tags, totalCount) = await _tagRepository.GetTagsWithDetailsPaged(pageNumber, pageSize);
30:             var dtos = _mapper.Map<List<TagListDto>>(tags);
31:             return PaginatedResult<TagListDto>.Create(dtos, totalCount, pageNumber, pageSize);
32:         }
33:     }
34: }
````

````csharp
 2: using AutoMapper;
 3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 4: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Tenant;
 5: using Explore.Application.Features.Tenants.Requests.Commands;
 6: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Tenant.Validators;
 7: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 8: using Explore.Domain;
 9: using FluentValidation;
10: using System;
11: 
12: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Tenants.Handlers.Commands
13: {
14:     public class CreateTenantCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateTenantCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
15:     {
16:         private readonly ITenantRepository _tenantRepository;
17:         private readonly IMapper _mapper;
18:         private readonly IValidator<CreateTenantDto> _validator;
19: 
20:         public CreateTenantCommandHandler(
21:             ITenantRepository tenantRepository,
22:             IMapper mapper,
23:             IValidator<CreateTenantDto> validator)
24:         {
25:             _tenantRepository = tenantRepository;
26:             _mapper = mapper;
27:             _validator = validator;
28:         }
29: 
30:         public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateTenantCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
31:         {
32:             var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
33: 
34:             var validationResult = await _validator.ValidateAsync(request.TenantDto);
35: 
36:             if (!validationResult.IsValid)
37:             {
38:                 response.Success = false;
39:                 response.Message = "Tenant creation failed.";
40:                 response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
41:                 return response;
42:             }
43: 
44:             var tenant = _mapper.Map<Tenant>(request.TenantDto);
45:             tenant = await _tenantRepository.Create(tenant);
46: 
47:             response.Success = true;
48:             response.Id = tenant.Id;
49:             response.Message = "Tenant created successfully.";
50: 
51:             return response;
52:         }
53:     }
54: }
````

````csharp
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using AutoMapper;
 3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using Explore.Application.DTOs.TenantUser;
 6: using Explore.Application.Features.TenantUsers.Requests.Commands;
````
