````csharp
263:     public Task<ProviderHealthInfo> GetHealthAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
264:     {
265: 
266:         return _inner.GetHealthAsync(cancellationToken);
267:     }
268: 
269: 
270: 
271: 
272: 
273:     private static string RedactKeyForLogging(string key)
274:     {
275:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
276:             return key;
277: 
278: 
279:         var parts = key.Split([':', '_', '.']);
280: 
281:         if (parts.Length == 0)
282:             return key;
283: 
284: 
285:         var lastPart = parts[^1];
286:         var isSensitive = SensitiveKeyPatterns.Any(pattern =>
287:             lastPart.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
288: 
289:         if (isSensitive)
290:         {
291: 
292:             return string.Join(":", parts[..^1]) + ":***";
293:         }
294: 
295:         return key;
296:     }
297: 
298: 
299: 
300: 
301:     private string GetCorrelationId()
302:     {
303: 
304:         var httpContext = _httpContextAccessor?.HttpContext;
305:         if (httpContext is not null)
306:         {
307: 
308:             if (httpContext.Request.Headers.TryGetValue("X-Correlation-Id", out var correlationHeader) &&
309:                 !string.IsNullOrEmpty(correlationHeader.ToString()))
310:             {
311:                 return correlationHeader.ToString();
312:             }
313: 
314:             if (httpContext.Request.Headers.TryGetValue("X-Request-Id", out var requestIdHeader) &&
315:                 !string.IsNullOrEmpty(requestIdHeader.ToString()))
316:             {
317:                 return requestIdHeader.ToString();
318:             }
319: 
320: 
321:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(httpContext.TraceIdentifier))
322:             {
323:                 return httpContext.TraceIdentifier;
324:             }
325:         }
326: 
327: 
328:         var activity = Activity.Current;
329:         if (activity is not null)
330:         {
331:             return activity.TraceId.ToString();
332:         }
333: 
334: 
335:         return Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8];
336:     }
337: 
338: 
339: 
340: 
341:     private string? GetUserId()
342:     {
343:         var httpContext = _httpContextAccessor?.HttpContext;
344:         if (httpContext?.User?.Identity?.IsAuthenticated != true)
345:         {
346:             return null;
347:         }
348: 
349: 
350:         var user = httpContext.User;
351: 
352: 
353:         var userId = user.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
354:             ?? user.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
355:             ?? user.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
356: 
357:         return userId;
358:     }
359: }
````

## File: Explore.Secrets/Providers/EnvironmentSecretProvider.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Secrets.Abstractions;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  3: 
  4: namespace Explore.Secrets.Providers;
  5: 
  6: 
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: public sealed class EnvironmentSecretProvider : ISecretProvider
 12: {
 13:     private readonly ILogger<EnvironmentSecretProvider> _logger;
 14:     private bool _initialized;
 15: 
 16:     public EnvironmentSecretProvider(ILogger<EnvironmentSecretProvider> logger)
 17:     {
 18:         _logger = logger;
 19:     }
 20: 
 21: 
 22:     public SecretProviderType ProviderType => SecretProviderType.None;
 23: 
 24: 
 25:     public bool SupportsRefresh => false;
 26: 
 27: 
 28:     public Task InitializeAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 29:     {
 30:         _initialized = true;
 31:         _logger.LogInformation("Environment secret provider initialized (no external secret manager)");
 32:         return Task.CompletedTask;
 33:     }
 34: 
 35: 
 36:     public Task<string?> GetSecretAsync(string key, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 37:     {
 38:         EnsureInitialized();
 39: 
 40:         var envVarName = ConvertKeyToEnvVar(key);
 41:         var value = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(envVarName);
 42: 
 43:         if (value is null)
 44:         {
 45: 
 46:             value = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(key.Replace(":", "__"));
 47:             if (value is null)
 48:             {
 49:                 value = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(key.Replace(":", "_"));
 50:             }
 51:         }
 52: 
 53:         if (value is not null)
 54:         {
 55:             _logger.LogDebug("Retrieved secret from environment variable: {Key}", RedactKey(key));
 56:         }
 57: 
 58:         return Task.FromResult(value);
 59:     }
 60: 
 61: 
 62:     public Task<SecretValue?> GetSecretWithMetadataAsync(string key, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 63:     {
 64:         var value = GetSecretAsync(key, cancellationToken).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
 65:         return Task.FromResult(value is not null ? new SecretValue(value) : null);
 66:     }
 67: 
 68: 
 69:     public Task<IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>> GetSecretsByPathAsync(
 70:         string pathPrefix,
 71:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 72:     {
 73:         EnsureInitialized();
 74: 
 75:         var envVarPrefix = ConvertKeyToEnvVar(pathPrefix);
 76:         var results = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
 77: 
 78:         foreach (var envVar in Environment.GetEnvironmentVariables().Keys.Cast<string>())
 79:         {
 80:             if (envVar.StartsWith(envVarPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 81:             {
 82:                 var value = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(envVar);
 83:                 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
 84:                 {
 85:                     var key = ConvertEnvVarToKey(envVar);
 86:                     results[key] = value;
 87:                 }
 88:             }
 89:         }
 90: 
 91:         _logger.LogDebug(
 92:             "Retrieved {Count} secrets from environment with prefix: {Prefix}",
 93:             results.Count,
 94:             RedactKey(pathPrefix));
 95: 
 96:         return Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>>(results);
 97:     }
 98: 
 99: 
100:     public Task RefreshAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
101:     {
102: 
103:         _logger.LogDebug("Refresh requested but environment variables don't support refresh");
104:         return Task.CompletedTask;
105:     }
106: 
107: 
108:     public Task<ProviderHealthInfo> GetHealthAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
109:     {
110: 
111:         return Task.FromResult(new ProviderHealthInfo(
112:             IsHealthy: _initialized,
113:             ProviderType: SecretProviderType.None,
114:             LastSuccessfulRefresh: null,
115:             ConsecutiveFailures: 0));
116:     }
117: 
118: 
119: 
120: 
121: 
122:     private static string ConvertKeyToEnvVar(string key)
123:     {
124:         return key
125:             .Replace(":", "__")
126:             .Replace(".", "__")
127:             .ToUpperInvariant();
128:     }
129: 
130: 
131: 
132: 
133: 
134:     private static string ConvertEnvVarToKey(string envVar)
135:     {
136: 
137:         var parts = envVar.Split("__", StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
138:         var capitalizedParts = parts.Select(p =>
139:             char.ToUpperInvariant(p[0]) + p[1..].ToLowerInvariant());
140:         return string.Join(":", capitalizedParts);
141:     }
142: 
143: 
144: 
145: 
146: 
147:     private static string RedactKey(string key)
148:     {
149:         var colonIndex = key.IndexOf(':');
150:         return colonIndex > 0 ? key[..(colonIndex + 1)] + "***" : key;
151:     }
152: 
153:     private void EnsureInitialized()
154:     {
155:         if (!_initialized)
156:         {
157:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
158:                 "Environment secret provider not initialized. Call InitializeAsync first.");
159:         }
160:     }
161: }
````

````csharp
 59:                 _options.Environment);
 60: 
 61:             var settings = new InfisicalSdkSettingsBuilder()
 62:                 .WithHostUri(_options.Url ?? "https://app.infisical.com")
 63:                 .Build();
 64: 
 65:             _client = new InfisicalClient(settings);
 66: 
 67: 
 68:             await _client.Auth().UniversalAuth().LoginAsync(
 69:                 _options.ClientId!,
 70:                 _options.ClientSecret!);
 71: 
 72:             _logger.LogDebug("Infisical authentication successful");
 73: 
 74: 
 75:             await LoadSecretsAsync(cancellationToken);
 76: 
 77:             _initialized = true;
 78:             _lastSuccessfulRefresh = DateTime.UtcNow;
 79:             _consecutiveFailures = 0;
 80: 
 81:             _logger.LogInformation(
 82:                 "Infisical secret provider initialized with {Count} secrets from {PathCount} paths",
 83:                 _secretCache.Count,
 84:                 _options.Paths.Count);
 85:         }
 86:         catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
 87:         {
 88:             _consecutiveFailures++;
 89:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to initialize Infisical secret provider");
 90:             throw SecretProviderException.Permanent(
 91:                 $"Failed to initialize Infisical provider: {ex.Message}",
 92:                 SecretProviderType.Infisical,
 93:                 "Initialize",
 94:                 ex);
 95:         }
 96:         finally
 97:         {
 98:             _initLock.Release();
 99:         }
100:     }
101: 
102: 
103:     public Task<string?> GetSecretAsync(string key, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
104:     {
105:         EnsureInitialized();
106: 
107:         if (_secretCache.TryGetValue(key, out var secret))
108:         {
109:             _logger.LogDebug("Retrieved secret from cache: {Key}", RedactKey(key));
110:             return Task.FromResult<string?>(secret.Value);
111:         }
112: 
113: 
114:         var infisicalKey = ConvertToInfisicalKey(key);
115:         if (_secretCache.TryGetValue(infisicalKey, out secret))
116:         {
117:             _logger.LogDebug("Retrieved secret from cache using Infisical key: {Key}", RedactKey(key));
118:             return Task.FromResult<string?>(secret.Value);
119:         }
120: 
121:         _logger.LogDebug("Secret not found in cache: {Key}", RedactKey(key));
122:         return Task.FromResult<string?>(null);
123:     }

145:     public Task<IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>> GetSecretsByPathAsync(
146:         string pathPrefix,
147:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
148:     {
149:         EnsureInitialized();
150: 
151:         var results = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
152:         var normalizedPrefix = NormalizePath(pathPrefix);
153: 
154:         foreach (var (key, secret) in _secretCache)
155:         {
156: 
157:             if (key.StartsWith(normalizedPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
158:                 key.StartsWith(pathPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
159:             {
160:                 results[key] = secret.Value;
161:             }
162:         }
163: 
164:         _logger.LogDebug(
165:             "Retrieved {Count} secrets with prefix: {Prefix}",
166:             results.Count,
167:             RedactKey(pathPrefix));
168: 
169:         return Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>>(results);
170:     }

172: 
173:     public async Task RefreshAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
174:     {
175:         EnsureInitialized();
176: 
177:         await _refreshLock.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
178:         try
179:         {
180:             _logger.LogDebug("Refreshing secrets from Infisical");
181: 
182:             var previousCount = _secretCache.Count;
183:             await LoadSecretsAsync(cancellationToken);
184: 
185:             _lastSuccessfulRefresh = DateTime.UtcNow;
186:             _consecutiveFailures = 0;
187: 
188:             _logger.LogInformation(
189:                 "Refreshed {Count} secrets from Infisical (previous: {Previous})",
190:                 _secretCache.Count,
191:                 previousCount);
192:         }
193:         catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
194:         {
195:             _consecutiveFailures++;
196:             _logger.LogWarning(
197:                 ex,
198:                 "Failed to refresh secrets from Infisical (consecutive failures: {Failures})",
199:                 _consecutiveFailures);
200: 
201:             throw SecretProviderException.Transient(
202:                 $"Failed to refresh secrets: {ex.Message}",
203:                 SecretProviderType.Infisical,
204:                 "Refresh",
205:                 ex);
206:         }
207:         finally
208:         {
209:             _refreshLock.Release();
210:         }
211:     }

215:     {
216:         return Task.FromResult(new ProviderHealthInfo(
217:             IsHealthy: _initialized && _consecutiveFailures < 3,
218:             ProviderType: SecretProviderType.Infisical,
219:             LastSuccessfulRefresh: _lastSuccessfulRefresh,
220:             ConsecutiveFailures: _consecutiveFailures));
221:     }

223: 
224: 
225: 
226:     private async Task LoadSecretsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
227:     {
228:         if (_client is null)
229:         {
230:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Infisical client not initialized");
231:         }
232: 
233:         var newSecrets = new Dictionary<string, SecretValue>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
234: 
235:         foreach (var path in _options.Paths)
236:         {
237:             cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
238: 
239:             try
240:             {
241:                 var options = new ListSecretsOptions
242:                 {
243:                     ProjectId = _options.ProjectId!,
244:                     EnvironmentSlug = _options.Environment,
245:                     SecretPath = path,
246:                     Recursive = true,
247:                     ExpandSecretReferences = true,
248:                     ViewSecretValue = true
249:                 };
250: 
251:                 var secrets = await _client.Secrets().ListAsync(options);
252: 
253:                 if (secrets is null)
254:                 {
255:                     _logger.LogWarning("No secrets returned from Infisical for path: {Path}", path);
256:                     continue;
257:                 }
258: 
259:                 foreach (var secret in secrets)
260:                 {
261: 
262:                     var canonicalKey = ConvertToCanonicalKey(secret.SecretKey, path);
263:                     var secretValue = new SecretValue(
264:                         secret.SecretValue,
265:                         Version: secret.Version.ToString());
266: 
267:                     newSecrets[canonicalKey] = secretValue;
268:                     newSecrets[secret.SecretKey] = secretValue;
269: 
270:                     _logger.LogTrace("Loaded secret: {Key} from path: {Path}", RedactKey(canonicalKey), path);
271:                 }
272:             }
273:             catch (Exception ex)
274:             {
275:                 _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load secrets from path: {Path}", path);
276:                 throw;
277:             }
278:         }
279: 
280: 
281:         _secretCache.Clear();
282:         foreach (var (key, value) in newSecrets)
283:         {
284:             _secretCache[key] = value;
285:         }
286:     }
287: 
288: 
289: 
290: 
291: 
292:     private static string ConvertToCanonicalKey(string infisicalKey, string path)
293:     {
294: 
295:         var section = path.Trim('/').Replace("/", ":");
296: 
297: 
298:         var parts = infisicalKey.Split('_', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
299:         var pascalCaseParts = parts.Select(p =>
300:             char.ToUpperInvariant(p[0]) + p[1..].ToLowerInvariant());
301:         var pascalCaseKey = string.Join("", pascalCaseParts);
302: 
303:         // If path provides context, use it
304:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(section))
305:         {
306:             // Check if the key already starts with the section name
307:             var sectionParts = section.Split(':', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
308:             var firstSectionPart = sectionParts.FirstOrDefault()?.ToUpperInvariant();
309: 
310:             if (firstSectionPart is not null &&
311:                 infisicalKey.StartsWith(firstSectionPart, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
312:             {
313:                 // Key already includes section, just convert to Pascal
314:                 return pascalCaseKey.Replace(firstSectionPart,
315:                     char.ToUpperInvariant(firstSectionPart[0]) + firstSectionPart[1..].ToLowerInvariant());
316:             }
317: 
318:             return $"{char.ToUpperInvariant(section[0])}{section[1..]}:{pascalCaseKey}";
319:         }
320: 
321:         return pascalCaseKey;
322:     }
323: 
324:     /// <summary>
325:     /// Converts a canonical key to Infisical format.
326:     /// e.g., "Keycloak:PublicUrl" -> "KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_URL"
327: 
328:     private static string ConvertToInfisicalKey(string canonicalKey)
329:     {
330:         return canonicalKey
331:             .Replace(":", "_")
332:             .ToUpperInvariant();
333:     }
334: 
335: 
336: 
337: 
338:     private static string NormalizePath(string path)
339:     {
340:         return path.Trim('/').Replace("/", ":");
341:     }
342: 
343: 
344: 
345: 
346:     private void ValidateConfiguration()
347:     {
348:         var errors = new List<string>();
349: 
350:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_options.ProjectId))
351:             errors.Add("Infisical ProjectId is required");
352: 
353:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_options.ClientId))
354:             errors.Add("Infisical ClientId is required");
355: 
356:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_options.ClientSecret))
357:             errors.Add("Infisical ClientSecret is required");
358: 
359:         if (errors.Count > 0)
360:         {
361:             throw SecretProviderException.Permanent(
362:                 $"Invalid Infisical configuration: {string.Join(", ", errors)}",
363:                 SecretProviderType.Infisical,
364:                 "Initialize");
365:         }
366:     }
367: 
368: 
369: 
370: 
371:     private static string RedactKey(string key)
372:     {
373:         var separatorIndex = key.IndexOfAny([':', '_']);
374:         return separatorIndex > 0 ? key[..(separatorIndex + 1)] + "***" : key;
375:     }
376: 
377:     private void EnsureInitialized()
378:     {
379:         if (!_initialized)
380:         {
381:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
382:                 "Infisical secret provider not initialized. Call InitializeAsync first.");
383:         }
384:     }
385: 
386: 
387:     public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
388:     {
389:         _initLock.Dispose();
390:         _refreshLock.Dispose();
391: 
392: 
393:         if (_client is IDisposable disposable)
394:         {
395:             disposable.Dispose();
396:         }
397:         else if (_client is IAsyncDisposable asyncDisposable)
398:         {
399:             await asyncDisposable.DisposeAsync();
400:         }
401: 
402:         _client = null;
403:         _initialized = false;
404:     }
405: }
````

````csharp
 19: public sealed class AesEncryptionService : IEncryptionService
 20: {
 21:     private const int NonceSize = 12;
 22:     private const int TagSize = 16;
 23:     private const int KeySize = 32;
 24: 
 25:     private readonly Dictionary<int, byte[]> _keyVersions;
 26:     private readonly int _currentKeyVersion;
 27:     private readonly ILogger<AesEncryptionService>? _logger;
 28:     private bool _disposed;
 29: 
 30: 
 31: 
 32: 
 33: 
 34: 
 35:     public AesEncryptionService(
 36:         IOptions<EncryptionOptions> options,
 37:         ILogger<AesEncryptionService>? logger = null)
 38:     {
 39:         ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options);
 40:         ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options.Value);
 41: 
 42:         _logger = logger;
 43:         _keyVersions = new Dictionary<int, byte[]>();
 44:         var config = options.Value;
 45: 
 46: 
 47:         if (config.KeyVersions.Count > 0)
 48:         {
 49:             foreach (var (version, base64Key) in config.KeyVersions)
 50:             {
 51:                 var keyBytes = DecodeAndValidateKey(base64Key, version);
 52:                 _keyVersions[version] = keyBytes;
 53:             }
 54:         }
 55: 
 56:         else if (config.AutoLoadFromEnvironment)
 57:         {
 58:             var envKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(config.MasterKeyEnvironmentVariable);
 59:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(envKey))
 60:             {
 61:                 var keyBytes = DecodeAndValidateKey(envKey, 1);
 62:                 _keyVersions[1] = keyBytes;
 63:                 _logger?.LogDebug("Loaded encryption key version 1 from environment variable");
 64:             }
 65:         }
 66: 
 67:         if (_keyVersions.Count == 0)
 68:         {
 69:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
 70:                 "No encryption keys configured. Provide keys via EncryptionOptions.KeyVersions " +
 71:                 $"or set environment variable '{config.MasterKeyEnvironmentVariable}'.");
 72:         }
 73: 
 74:         _currentKeyVersion = config.CurrentKeyVersion;
 75:         if (!_keyVersions.ContainsKey(_currentKeyVersion))
 76:         {
 77:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
 78:                 $"Current key version {_currentKeyVersion} not found in available keys. " +
 79:                 $"Available versions: {string.Join(", ", _keyVersions.Keys)}");
 80:         }
 81: 
 82:         _logger?.LogInformation(
 83:             "AES encryption service initialized with {Count} key version(s), current version: {Version}",
 84:             _keyVersions.Count,
 85:             _currentKeyVersion);
 86:     }
 87: 
 88: 
 89: 
 90: 
 91: 
 92: 
 93: 
 94:     public AesEncryptionService(
 95:         Dictionary<int, byte[]> keyVersions,
 96:         int currentKeyVersion,
 97:         ILogger<AesEncryptionService>? logger = null)
 98:     {
 99:         ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(keyVersions);
100: 
101:         if (keyVersions.Count == 0)
102:         {
103:             throw new ArgumentException("At least one key version is required.", nameof(keyVersions));
104:         }
105: 
106:         _logger = logger;
107:         _keyVersions = new Dictionary<int, byte[]>();
108: 
109:         foreach (var (version, key) in keyVersions)
110:         {
111:             if (key.Length != KeySize)
112:             {
113:                 throw new ArgumentException(
114:                     $"Key version {version} must be exactly {KeySize} bytes (256 bits), got {key.Length} bytes.",
115:                     nameof(keyVersions));
116:             }
117: 
118: 
119:             var keyCopy = new byte[KeySize];
120:             key.CopyTo(keyCopy, 0);
121:             _keyVersions[version] = keyCopy;
122:         }
123: 
124:         if (!_keyVersions.ContainsKey(currentKeyVersion))
125:         {
126:             throw new ArgumentException(
127:                 $"Current key version {currentKeyVersion} not found in provided keys.",
128:                 nameof(currentKeyVersion));
129:         }
130: 
131:         _currentKeyVersion = currentKeyVersion;
132:     }
133: 
134: 
135:     public int CurrentKeyVersion => _currentKeyVersion;
136: 
137: 
138:     public IReadOnlyCollection<int> AvailableKeyVersions => _keyVersions.Keys.ToList().AsReadOnly();
139: 
140: 
141:     public EncryptionResult Encrypt(string plaintext)
142:     {
143:         ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
144:         ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(plaintext);
145: 
146:         var key = _keyVersions[_currentKeyVersion];
147:         var plaintextBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(plaintext);
148: 
149:         try
150:         {
151: 
152:             var nonce = new byte[NonceSize];
153:             var tag = new byte[TagSize];
154:             var ciphertext = new byte[plaintextBytes.Length];
155: 
156: 
157:             RandomNumberGenerator.Fill(nonce);
158: 
159: 
160:             using var aesGcm = new AesGcm(key, TagSize);
161:             aesGcm.Encrypt(nonce, plaintextBytes, ciphertext, tag);
162: 
163: 
164:             var result = new byte[NonceSize + TagSize + ciphertext.Length];
165:             Buffer.BlockCopy(nonce, 0, result, 0, NonceSize);
166:             Buffer.BlockCopy(tag, 0, result, NonceSize, TagSize);
167:             Buffer.BlockCopy(ciphertext, 0, result, NonceSize + TagSize, ciphertext.Length);
168: 
169:             var base64Result = Convert.ToBase64String(result);
170: 
171:             _logger?.LogDebug(
172:                 "Encrypted {Length} bytes using key version {Version}",
173:                 plaintextBytes.Length,
174:                 _currentKeyVersion);
175: 
176:             return new EncryptionResult(base64Result, _currentKeyVersion);
177:         }
178:         finally
179:         {
180: 
181:             CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(plaintextBytes);
182:         }
183:     }
184: 
185: 
186:     public string Decrypt(string ciphertext, int keyVersion)
187:     {
188:         ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
189:         ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(ciphertext);
190: 
191:         if (!_keyVersions.TryGetValue(keyVersion, out var key))
192:         {
193:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
194:                 $"Key version {keyVersion} not found. Available versions: {string.Join(", ", _keyVersions.Keys)}");
195:         }
196: 
197:         byte[] combined;
198:         try
199:         {
200:             combined = Convert.FromBase64String(ciphertext);
201:         }
202:         catch (FormatException ex)
203:         {
204:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid ciphertext format: not valid base64.", ex);
205:         }
206: 
207:         if (combined.Length < NonceSize + TagSize)
208:         {
209:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
210:                 $"Invalid ciphertext: too short. Expected at least {NonceSize + TagSize} bytes, got {combined.Length}.");
211:         }
212: 
213: 
214:         var nonce = new byte[NonceSize];
215:         var tag = new byte[TagSize];
216:         var encryptedData = new byte[combined.Length - NonceSize - TagSize];
217: 
218:         Buffer.BlockCopy(combined, 0, nonce, 0, NonceSize);
219:         Buffer.BlockCopy(combined, NonceSize, tag, 0, TagSize);
220:         Buffer.BlockCopy(combined, NonceSize + TagSize, encryptedData, 0, encryptedData.Length);
221: 
222:         var plaintextBytes = new byte[encryptedData.Length];
223: 
224:         try
225:         {
226:             using var aesGcm = new AesGcm(key, TagSize);
227:             aesGcm.Decrypt(nonce, encryptedData, tag, plaintextBytes);
228: 
229:             var plaintext = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(plaintextBytes);
230: 
231:             _logger?.LogDebug(
232:                 "Decrypted {Length} bytes using key version {Version}",
233:                 encryptedData.Length,
234:                 keyVersion);
235: 
236:             return plaintext;
237:         }
238:         catch (AuthenticationTagMismatchException ex)
239:         {
240:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
241:                 "Decryption failed: authentication tag mismatch. Data may be corrupted or tampered.", ex);
242:         }
243:         finally
244:         {
245: 
246:             CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(plaintextBytes);
247:         }
248:     }
249: 
250: 
251:     public bool HasKeyVersion(int keyVersion)
252:     {
253:         ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
254:         return _keyVersions.ContainsKey(keyVersion);
255:     }
256: 
257: 
258: 
259: 
260:     private static byte[] DecodeAndValidateKey(string base64Key, int version)
261:     {
262:         byte[] keyBytes;
263:         try
264:         {
265:             keyBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(base64Key);
266:         }
267:         catch (FormatException ex)
268:         {
269:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
270:                 $"Key version {version} is not valid base64.", ex);
271:         }
272: 
273:         if (keyBytes.Length != KeySize)
274:         {
275:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
276:                 $"Key version {version} must be exactly {KeySize} bytes (256 bits), " +
277:                 $"got {keyBytes.Length} bytes.");
278:         }
279: 
280:         return keyBytes;
281:     }
282: 
283: 
284:     public void Dispose()
285:     {
286:         if (_disposed)
287:         {
288:             return;
289:         }
290: 
291: 
292:         foreach (var key in _keyVersions.Values)
293:         {
294:             CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(key);
295:         }
296: 
297:         _keyVersions.Clear();
298:         _disposed = true;
299: 
300:         _logger?.LogDebug("AES encryption service disposed, key material zeroed");
301:     }
302: }
````

````csharp
 85:     public async Task<KeyRotationResult> ReEncryptAllAsync(
 86:         GetSettingsToRotateAsync getSettings,
 87:         UpdateSettingAsync updateSetting,
 88:         IProgress<KeyRotationProgress>? progress = null,
 89:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 90:     {
 91:         ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(getSettings);
 92:         ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(updateSetting);
 93: 
 94:         var currentVersion = _encryptionService.CurrentKeyVersion;
 95:         _logger?.LogInformation(
 96:             "Starting key rotation to version {Version}",
 97:             currentVersion);
 98: 
 99:         var settings = await getSettings(currentVersion).ConfigureAwait(false);
100:         var total = settings.Count;
101: 
102:         _logger?.LogInformation(
103:             "Found {Count} settings to re-encrypt",
104:             total);
105: 
106:         if (total == 0)
107:         {
108:             return new KeyRotationResult(0, 0, 0, 0, []);
109:         }
110: 
111:         var reEncryptedCount = 0;
112:         var skippedCount = 0;
113:         var errors = new List<KeyRotationError>();
114:         var current = 0;
115: 
116:         foreach (var setting in settings)
117:         {
118:             cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
119: 
120:             current++;
121:             progress?.Report(new KeyRotationProgress(current, total, setting.Key));
122: 
123: 
124:             if (setting.KeyVersion >= currentVersion)
125:             {
126:                 _logger?.LogDebug(
127:                     "Skipping {Key}: already at version {Version}",
128:                     setting.Key, setting.KeyVersion);
129:                 skippedCount++;
130:                 continue;
131:             }
132: 
133: 
134:             if (!_encryptionService.HasKeyVersion(setting.KeyVersion))
135:             {
136:                 var error = $"Missing key version {setting.KeyVersion}";
137:                 _logger?.LogError(
138:                     "Cannot re-encrypt {Key}: {Error}",
139:                     setting.Key, error);
140:                 errors.Add(new KeyRotationError(setting.Key, setting.KeyVersion, error));
141:                 continue;
142:             }
143: 
144:             try
145:             {
146: 
147:                 var plaintext = _encryptionService.Decrypt(
148:                     setting.EncryptedValue,
149:                     setting.KeyVersion);
150: 
151: 
152:                 var result = _encryptionService.Encrypt(plaintext);
153: 
154: 
155:                 await updateSetting(
156:                     setting.Key,
157:                     result.Ciphertext,
158:                     result.KeyVersion,
159:                     DateTime.UtcNow).ConfigureAwait(false);
160: 
161:                 reEncryptedCount++;
162:                 _logger?.LogDebug(
163:                     "Re-encrypted {Key}: v{OldVersion} -> v{NewVersion}",
164:                     setting.Key, setting.KeyVersion, result.KeyVersion);
165:             }
166:             catch (Exception ex)
167:             {
168:                 _logger?.LogError(ex,
169:                     "Failed to re-encrypt {Key}",
170:                     setting.Key);
171:                 errors.Add(new KeyRotationError(setting.Key, setting.KeyVersion, ex.Message));
172:             }
173:         }
174: 
175:         _logger?.LogInformation(
176:             "Key rotation complete: {ReEncrypted} re-encrypted, {Skipped} skipped, {Errors} errors",
177:             reEncryptedCount, skippedCount, errors.Count);
178: 
179:         return new KeyRotationResult(
180:             total,
181:             reEncryptedCount,
182:             skippedCount,
183:             errors.Count,
184:             errors.AsReadOnly());
185:     }
186: 
187: 
188: 
189: 
190: 
191: 
192: 
193:     public EncryptionResult ReEncryptSingle(string encryptedValue, int oldKeyVersion)
194:     {
195:         ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(encryptedValue);
196: 
197:         if (!_encryptionService.HasKeyVersion(oldKeyVersion))
198:         {
199:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
200:                 $"Cannot re-encrypt: key version {oldKeyVersion} not available.");
201:         }
202: 
203:         var plaintext = _encryptionService.Decrypt(encryptedValue, oldKeyVersion);
204:         return _encryptionService.Encrypt(plaintext);
205:     }
206: }
````

````csharp
 24: public sealed class RotationAwareDbContextFactory<TContext> : IDbContextFactory<TContext>, IDisposable
 25:     where TContext : DbContext
 26: {
 27:     private readonly Func<DbContextOptions<TContext>, TContext> _contextFactory;
 28:     private readonly IOptionsMonitor<DatabaseConnectionOptions> _connectionOptions;
 29:     private readonly IOptionsMonitor<RotationOptions> _rotationOptions;
 30:     private readonly ILogger<RotationAwareDbContextFactory<TContext>> _logger;
 31:     private readonly IDisposable? _connectionChangeListener;
 32:     private readonly object _optionsLock = new();
 33: 
 34:     private string? _currentConnectionString;
 35:     private DateTime _lastConnectionStringChange;
 36:     private int _rotationCount;
 37:     private bool _disposed;
 38: 
 39: 
 40: 
 41: 
 42: 
 43: 
 44: 
 45: 
 46:     public RotationAwareDbContextFactory(
 47:         Func<DbContextOptions<TContext>, TContext> contextFactory,
 48:         IOptionsMonitor<DatabaseConnectionOptions> connectionOptions,
 49:         IOptionsMonitor<RotationOptions> rotationOptions,
 50:         ILogger<RotationAwareDbContextFactory<TContext>> logger)
 51:     {
 52:         _contextFactory = contextFactory ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(contextFactory));
 53:         _connectionOptions = connectionOptions ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(connectionOptions));
 54:         _rotationOptions = rotationOptions ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(rotationOptions));
 55:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
 56: 
 57: 
 58:         _currentConnectionString = connectionOptions.CurrentValue.ConnectionString;
 59:         _lastConnectionStringChange = DateTime.UtcNow;
 60: 
 61: 
 62:         _connectionChangeListener = _connectionOptions.OnChange(OnConnectionOptionsChanged);
 63: 
 64:         _logger.LogDebug(
 65:             "RotationAwareDbContextFactory<{ContextType}> initialized",
 66:             typeof(TContext).Name);
 67:     }
 68: 
 69: 
 70: 
 71: 
 72:     public int RotationCount => _rotationCount;
 73: 
 74: 
 75: 
 76: 
 77:     public DateTime LastConnectionStringChange => _lastConnectionStringChange;
 78: 
 79: 
 80: 
 81: 
 82:     public string? CurrentConnectionStringRedacted => RedactConnectionString(_currentConnectionString);
 83: 
 84: 
 85: 
 86: 
 87: 
 88:     public TContext CreateDbContext()
 89:     {
 90:         ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
 91: 
 92:         string? connectionString;
 93:         lock (_optionsLock)
 94:         {
 95:             connectionString = _currentConnectionString;
 96:         }
 97: 
 98:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(connectionString))
 99:         {
100:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
101:                 $"Connection string is not configured for {typeof(TContext).Name}. " +
102:                 $"Ensure DatabaseConnectionOptions is properly configured.");
103:         }
104: 
105:         var optionsBuilder = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<TContext>();
106:         ConfigureDbContextOptions(optionsBuilder, connectionString);
107: 
108:         var context = _contextFactory(optionsBuilder.Options);
109: 
110:         _logger.LogTrace(
111:             "Created DbContext<{ContextType}> (rotations: {RotationCount})",
112:             typeof(TContext).Name,
113:             _rotationCount);
114: 
115:         return context;
116:     }
117: 
118: 
119: 
120: 
121:     private void ConfigureDbContextOptions(
122:         DbContextOptionsBuilder<TContext> optionsBuilder,
123:         string connectionString)
124:     {
125:         var dbOptions = _connectionOptions.CurrentValue;
126: 
127: 
128:         var npgsqlConnectionString = connectionString;
129: 
130: 
131: 
132:         if (dbOptions.MaxPoolSize.HasValue)
133:         {
134:             _logger.LogDebug("MaxPoolSize configured: {MaxPoolSize}", dbOptions.MaxPoolSize);
135:         }
136: 
137:         optionsBuilder.UseNpgsql(npgsqlConnectionString);
138:     }
139: 
140:     private void OnConnectionOptionsChanged(DatabaseConnectionOptions newOptions, string? name)
141:     {
142:         if (!_rotationOptions.CurrentValue.Enabled)
143:         {
144:             _logger.LogDebug("Connection rotation is disabled, ignoring change");
145:             return;
146:         }
147: 
148:         var newConnectionString = newOptions.ConnectionString;
149: 
150:         lock (_optionsLock)
151:         {
152: 
153:             if (string.Equals(_currentConnectionString, newConnectionString, StringComparison.Ordinal))
154:             {
155:                 _logger.LogDebug("Connection string unchanged, skipping rotation");
156:                 return;
157:             }
158: 
159:             _currentConnectionString = newConnectionString;
160:             _lastConnectionStringChange = DateTime.UtcNow;
161:             Interlocked.Increment(ref _rotationCount);
162:         }
163: 
164:         if (_rotationOptions.CurrentValue.LogRotationEvents)
165:         {
166:             _logger.LogInformation(
167:                 "Connection string rotated for {ContextType} (rotation #{RotationCount}). New connection: {ConnectionString}",
168:                 typeof(TContext).Name,
169:                 _rotationCount,
170:                 RedactConnectionString(newConnectionString));
171:         }
172:     }
173: 
174: 
175: 
176: 
177:     private static string? RedactConnectionString(string? connectionString)
178:     {
179:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(connectionString))
180:         {
181:             return null;
182:         }
183: 
184: 
185:         var patterns = new[]
186:         {
187:             ("Password=", "Password=***"),
188:             ("password=", "password=***"),
189:             ("Pwd=", "Pwd=***"),
190:             ("pwd=", "pwd=***"),
191:             ("Secret=", "Secret=***"),
192:             ("secret=", "secret=***"),
193:         };
194: 
195:         var redacted = connectionString;
196:         foreach (var (pattern, replacement) in patterns)
197:         {
198:             var index = redacted.IndexOf(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
199:             if (index >= 0)
200:             {
201:                 var endIndex = redacted.IndexOf(';', index);
202:                 if (endIndex > 0)
203:                 {
204:                     redacted = redacted[..index] + replacement + redacted[endIndex..];
205:                 }
206:                 else
207:                 {
208:                     redacted = redacted[..index] + replacement;
209:                 }
210:             }
211:         }
212: 
213:         return redacted;
214:     }
215: 
216: 
217: 
218: 
219: 
220:     public void ForceRefresh()
221:     {
222:         ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
223: 
224:         var currentOptions = _connectionOptions.CurrentValue;
225:         OnConnectionOptionsChanged(currentOptions, null);
226:     }
227: 
228: 
229: 
230: 
231:     public void Dispose()
232:     {
233:         if (_disposed)
234:         {
235:             return;
236:         }
237: 
238:         _disposed = true;
239: 
240:         _logger.LogDebug(
241:             "Disposing RotationAwareDbContextFactory<{ContextType}> (total rotations: {RotationCount})",
242:             typeof(TContext).Name,
243:             _rotationCount);
244: 
245:         _connectionChangeListener?.Dispose();
246:     }
247: }
248: 
249: 
250: 
251: 
252: public interface IRotationAwareDbContextFactory
253: {
254: 
255: 
256: 
257:     int RotationCount { get; }
258: 
259: 
260: 
261: 
262:     DateTime LastConnectionStringChange { get; }
263: 
264: 
265: 
266: 
267:     string? CurrentConnectionStringRedacted { get; }
268: 
269: 
270: 
271: 
272:     void ForceRefresh();
273: }
````

````csharp
 19: public sealed class RotationAwareHttpClientFactory : IHttpClientFactory, IDisposable
 20: {
 21:     private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, ClientEntry> _clients = new();
 22:     private readonly IOptionsMonitor<HttpClientCredentialOptions> _credentialOptions;
 23:     private readonly IOptionsMonitor<RotationOptions> _rotationOptions;
 24:     private readonly ILogger<RotationAwareHttpClientFactory> _logger;
 25:     private readonly IDisposable? _credentialChangeListener;
 26:     private readonly SemaphoreSlim _rotationSemaphore;
 27:     private readonly object _disposeLock = new();
 28:     private bool _disposed;
 29: 
 30: 
 31: 
 32: 
 33:     public RotationAwareHttpClientFactory(
 34:         IOptionsMonitor<HttpClientCredentialOptions> credentialOptions,
 35:         IOptionsMonitor<RotationOptions> rotationOptions,
 36:         ILogger<RotationAwareHttpClientFactory> logger)
 37:     {
 38:         _credentialOptions = credentialOptions ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(credentialOptions));
 39:         _rotationOptions = rotationOptions ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(rotationOptions));
 40:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
 41:         _rotationSemaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(rotationOptions.CurrentValue.MaxConcurrentRotations);
 42: 
 43: 
 44:         _credentialChangeListener = _credentialOptions.OnChange(OnCredentialsChanged);
 45: 
 46:         _logger.LogDebug("RotationAwareHttpClientFactory initialized");
 47:     }
 48: 
 49: 
 50: 
 51: 
 52: 
 53: 
 54:     public HttpClient CreateClient(string name)
 55:     {
 56:         ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
 57: 
 58:         var entry = _clients.GetOrAdd(name, CreateClientEntry);
 59:         return entry.Client;
 60:     }
 61: 
 62: 
 63: 
 64: 
 65:     public int ActiveClientCount => _clients.Count;
 66: 
 67: 
 68: 
 69: 
 70:     public bool HasClient(string name) => _clients.ContainsKey(name);
 71: 
 72:     private ClientEntry CreateClientEntry(string name)
 73:     {
 74:         var client = CreateHttpClientInternal(name);
 75:         _logger.LogDebug("Created new HTTP client for '{Name}'", name);
 76:         return new ClientEntry(client, DateTime.UtcNow);
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     private HttpClient CreateHttpClientInternal(string name)
 80:     {
 81:         var client = new HttpClient();
 82:         var credentials = _credentialOptions.CurrentValue;
 83: 
 84:         if (credentials.Clients.TryGetValue(name, out var clientCred))
 85:         {
 86:             ApplyCredentials(client, clientCred, name);
 87:         }
 88: 
 89:         return client;
 90:     }
 91: 
 92:     private void ApplyCredentials(HttpClient client, HttpClientCredential credential, string name)
 93:     {
 94: 
 95:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(credential.BaseAddress))
 96:         {
 97:             client.BaseAddress = new Uri(credential.BaseAddress);
 98:         }
 99: 
100: 
101:         if (credential.Timeout.HasValue)
102:         {
103:             client.Timeout = credential.Timeout.Value;
104:         }
105: 
106: 
107:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(credential.BearerToken))
108:         {
109:             client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization =
110:                 new System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", credential.BearerToken);
111:         }
112: 
113: 
114:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(credential.ApiKey))
115:         {
116:             client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("X-API-Key", credential.ApiKey);
117:         }
118: 
119: 
120:         foreach (var header in credential.Headers)
121:         {
122:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(header.Value))
123:             {
124:                 client.DefaultRequestHeaders.TryAddWithoutValidation(header.Key, header.Value);
125:             }
126:         }
127: 
128:         _logger.LogDebug(
129:             "Applied credentials to HTTP client '{Name}' (BaseAddress: {BaseAddress})",
130:             name,
131:             credential.BaseAddress ?? "not set");
132:     }
133: 
134:     private void OnCredentialsChanged(HttpClientCredentialOptions newCredentials, string? name)
135:     {
136:         if (!_rotationOptions.CurrentValue.Enabled)
137:         {
138:             _logger.LogDebug("Credential rotation is disabled, ignoring change");
139:             return;
140:         }
141: 
142:         _logger.LogInformation("HTTP client credentials changed, initiating rotation");
143: 
144: 
145:         foreach (var clientName in newCredentials.Clients.Keys)
146:         {
147:             if (_clients.ContainsKey(clientName))
148:             {
149:                 _ = RotateClientAsync(clientName);
150:             }
151:         }
152:     }
153: 
154:     private async Task RotateClientAsync(string name)
155:     {
156:         try
157:         {
158: 
159:             if (!await _rotationSemaphore.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)))
160:             {
161:                 _logger.LogWarning(
162:                     "Rotation for client '{Name}' skipped - too many concurrent rotations",
163:                     name);
164:                 return;
165:             }
166: 
167:             try
168:             {
169:                 await RotateClientInternalAsync(name);
170:             }
171:             finally
172:             {
173:                 _rotationSemaphore.Release();
174:             }
175:         }
176:         catch (Exception ex)
177:         {
178:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to rotate HTTP client '{Name}'", name);
179:         }
180:     }
181: 
182:     private async Task RotateClientInternalAsync(string name)
183:     {
184:         var rotationOptions = _rotationOptions.CurrentValue;
185: 
186:         if (rotationOptions.LogRotationEvents)
187:         {
188:             _logger.LogInformation("Rotating HTTP client '{Name}'", name);
189:         }
190: 
191: 
192:         var newEntry = CreateClientEntry(name);
193: 
194: 
195:         if (_clients.TryGetValue(name, out var oldEntry))
196:         {
197:             _clients[name] = newEntry;
198: 
199:             if (rotationOptions.LogRotationEvents)
200:             {
201:                 _logger.LogDebug(
202:                     "Swapped HTTP client '{Name}', scheduling disposal after {GracePeriod}",
203:                     name,
204:                     rotationOptions.GracePeriod);
205:             }
206: 
207: 
208:             _ = DisposeAfterGracePeriodAsync(oldEntry.Client, name, rotationOptions.GracePeriod);
209:         }
210:         else
211:         {
212: 
213:             _clients[name] = newEntry;
214:         }
215: 
216:         await Task.CompletedTask;
217:     }
218: 
219:     private async Task DisposeAfterGracePeriodAsync(HttpClient client, string name, TimeSpan gracePeriod)
220:     {
221:         try
222:         {
223:             await Task.Delay(gracePeriod);
224:             client.Dispose();
225: 
226:             if (_rotationOptions.CurrentValue.LogRotationEvents)
227:             {
228:                 _logger.LogDebug(
229:                     "Disposed old HTTP client '{Name}' after grace period",
230:                     name);
231:             }
232:         }
233:         catch (Exception ex)
234:         {
235:             _logger.LogError(
236:                 ex,
237:                 "Error disposing old HTTP client '{Name}' after grace period",
238:                 name);
239:         }
240:     }
241: 
242: 
243: 
244: 
245: 
246:     public async Task ForceRotateAsync(string name)
247:     {
248:         ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
249: 
250:         if (!_clients.ContainsKey(name))
251:         {
252:             throw new ArgumentException($"No client with name '{name}' exists", nameof(name));
253:         }
254: 
255:         await RotateClientAsync(name);
256:     }
257: 
258: 
259: 
260: 
261:     public async Task ForceRotateAllAsync()
262:     {
263:         ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
264: 
265:         var tasks = _clients.Keys.Select(RotateClientAsync);
266:         await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
267:     }
268: 
269: 
270: 
271: 
272:     public void Dispose()
273:     {
274:         lock (_disposeLock)
275:         {
276:             if (_disposed)
277:             {
278:                 return;
279:             }
280: 
281:             _disposed = true;
282:         }
283: 
284:         _logger.LogDebug("Disposing RotationAwareHttpClientFactory");
285: 
286: 
287:         _credentialChangeListener?.Dispose();
288: 
289: 
290:         foreach (var entry in _clients.Values)
291:         {
292:             try
293:             {
294:                 entry.Client.Dispose();
295:             }
296:             catch (Exception ex)
297:             {
298:                 _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error disposing HTTP client during factory disposal");
299:             }
300:         }
301: 
302:         _clients.Clear();
303:         _rotationSemaphore.Dispose();
304: 
305:         _logger.LogDebug("RotationAwareHttpClientFactory disposed");
306:     }
307: 
308: 
309: 
310: 
311:     private sealed record ClientEntry(HttpClient Client, DateTime CreatedAt);
312: }
````

## File: Explore.Secrets/Services/SecretRefreshService.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Secrets.Abstractions;
  2: using Explore.Secrets.Configuration;
  3: using Explore.Secrets.Observability;
  4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
  5: using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;

  7: using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
  8: 
  9: namespace Explore.Secrets.Services;
 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13: 
 14: 
 15: public sealed class SecretRefreshService : BackgroundService
 16: {
 17:     private readonly ISecretProvider _secretProvider;
 18:     private readonly IConfigurationRoot? _configuration;
 19:     private readonly SecretRefreshOptions _options;
 20:     private readonly SecretRefreshMetrics _metrics;
 21:     private readonly ILogger<SecretRefreshService> _logger;
 22: 
 23:     private int _consecutiveFailures;
 24:     private DateTime? _lastSuccessfulRefresh;
 25: 
 26:     public SecretRefreshService(
 27:         ISecretProvider secretProvider,
 28:         IConfiguration configuration,
 29:         IOptions<SecretRefreshOptions> options,
 30:         SecretRefreshMetrics metrics,
 31:         ILogger<SecretRefreshService> logger)
 32:     {
 33:         _secretProvider = secretProvider;
 34:         _configuration = configuration as IConfigurationRoot;
 35:         _options = options.Value;
 36:         _metrics = metrics;
 37:         _logger = logger;
 38:     }
 39: 
 40: 
 41: 
 42: 
 43:     public int ConsecutiveFailures => _consecutiveFailures;
 44: 
 45: 
 46: 
 47: 
 48:     public DateTime? LastSuccessfulRefresh => _lastSuccessfulRefresh;
 49: 
 50:     protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
 51:     {
 52:         if (!_options.Enabled)
 53:         {
 54:             _logger.LogInformation("Secret refresh service is disabled");
 55:             return;
 56:         }
 57: 
 58:         if (!_secretProvider.SupportsRefresh)
 59:         {
 60:             _logger.LogInformation(
 61:                 "Secret provider {Provider} does not support refresh, service will not run",
 62:                 _secretProvider.ProviderType);
 63:             return;
 64:         }
 65: 
 66:         _logger.LogInformation(
 67:             "Secret refresh service starting with interval {Interval}",
 68:             _options.RefreshInterval);
 69: 
 70: 
 71:         var initialDelay = _options.AddJitter(_options.InitialDelay);
 72:         _logger.LogDebug("Waiting {Delay} before first refresh", initialDelay);
 73: 
 74:         try
 75:         {
 76:             await Task.Delay(initialDelay, stoppingToken);
 77:         }
 78:         catch (OperationCanceledException)
 79:         {
 80:             return;
 81:         }
 82: 
 83: 
 84:         using var timer = new PeriodicTimer(_options.RefreshInterval);
 85: 
 86:         while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
 87:         {
 88:             await RefreshSecretsAsync(stoppingToken);
 89: 
 90:             try
 91:             {
 92: 
 93:                 var waitTime = CalculateNextWaitTime();
 94: 
 95:                 if (waitTime != _options.RefreshInterval)
 96:                 {
 97: 
 98:                     await Task.Delay(waitTime, stoppingToken);
 99:                 }
100:                 else
101:                 {
102: 
103:                     await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stoppingToken);
104:                 }
105:             }
106:             catch (OperationCanceledException)
107:             {
108:                 break;
109:             }
110:         }
111: 
112:         _logger.LogInformation("Secret refresh service stopped");
113:     }
114: 
115:     private async Task RefreshSecretsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
116:     {
117:         using var operation = _metrics.StartRefreshOperation(_secretProvider.ProviderType);
118: 
119:         try
120:         {
121:             _logger.LogDebug(
122:                 "Starting secret refresh (consecutive failures: {Failures})",
123:                 _consecutiveFailures);
124: 
125:             await _secretProvider.RefreshAsync(cancellationToken);
126: 
127: 
128:             if (_configuration is not null)
129:             {
130:                 _configuration.Reload();
131:                 _logger.LogDebug("Configuration reloaded after secret refresh");
132:             }
133: 
134:             _consecutiveFailures = 0;
135:             _lastSuccessfulRefresh = DateTime.UtcNow;
136:             operation.Complete();
137: 
138:             _logger.LogInformation("Secret refresh completed successfully");
139:         }
140:         catch (SecretProviderException ex) when (ex.IsTransient)
141:         {
142:             _consecutiveFailures++;
143:             operation.Fail("transient");
144: 
145:             _logger.LogWarning(
146:                 ex,
147:                 "Transient error during secret refresh (failures: {Failures}, operation: {Operation})",
148:                 _consecutiveFailures,
149:                 ex.Operation);
150:         }
151:         catch (SecretProviderException ex)
152:         {
153:             _consecutiveFailures++;
154:             operation.Fail("permanent");
155: 
156:             _logger.LogError(
157:                 ex,
158:                 "Permanent error during secret refresh (failures: {Failures}, operation: {Operation})",
159:                 _consecutiveFailures,
160:                 ex.Operation);
161:         }
162:         catch (OperationCanceledException)
163:         {
164: 
165:             _logger.LogDebug("Secret refresh cancelled");
166:             throw;
167:         }
168:         catch (Exception ex)
169:         {
170:             _consecutiveFailures++;
171:             operation.Fail("unknown");
172: 
173:             _logger.LogError(
174:                 ex,
175:                 "Unexpected error during secret refresh (failures: {Failures})",
176:                 _consecutiveFailures);
177:         }
178:     }
179: 
180:     private TimeSpan CalculateNextWaitTime()
181:     {
182:         if (_consecutiveFailures == 0)
183:         {
184: 
185:             return _options.AddJitter(_options.RefreshInterval);
186:         }
187: 
188: 
189:         var backoff = _options.CalculateBackoffDelay(_consecutiveFailures);
190: 
191:         _logger.LogDebug(
192:             "Using backoff delay {Delay} after {Failures} consecutive failures",
193:             backoff,
194:             _consecutiveFailures);
195: 
196:         return backoff;
197:     }
198: 
199:     public override async Task StopAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
200:     {
201:         _logger.LogInformation(
202:             "Secret refresh service stopping (last success: {LastSuccess}, failures: {Failures})",
203:             _lastSuccessfulRefresh,
204:             _consecutiveFailures);
205: 
206:         await base.StopAsync(cancellationToken);
207:     }
208: }
````

````csharp
53:             args:
54:             [
55:                 entry.Operation.ToString(),
56:                 entry.ProviderType.ToString(),
57:                 entry.Success ? "succeeded" : "failed",
58:                 entry.KeyPattern ?? "(none)"
59:             ]);
60:

63:         {

71:                 entry.Success,
72:                 entry.UserId ?? "anonymous",
73:                 entry.CorrelationId ?? "none",
74:                 entry.Timestamp.ToString("O"),
75:                 entry.ErrorMessage ?? "none");
````
