115: 
116: ## ⚡ Quick Reference
117: 
118: ### 1. YARP Reverse Proxy Configuration
119: 
120: **Purpose**: Forward API requests from BFF to backend API with token attachment.
121: 
122: **Generic Template**:
123: 
124: ```csharp
125: // File: {Project}.Blazor/Program.cs
126: var {project}ApiBaseUrl = builder.Configuration["{Project}Api:BaseUrl"] ?? "https://localhost:7039/";
127: 
128: var proxyRoutes = new[]
129: {
130:     new RouteConfig
131:     {
132:         RouteId = "{project}-api",
133:         ClusterId = "{project}-api",
134:         Match = new RouteMatch
135:         {
136:             Path = "/api/v1/{**catchall}"  // Catch all API routes
137:         }
138:     }
139: };
140: 
141: var proxyClusters = new[]
142: {
143:     new ClusterConfig
144:     {
145:         ClusterId = "{project}-api",
146:         Destinations = new Dictionary<string, DestinationConfig>
147:         {
148:             ["primary"] = new() { Address = {project}ApiBaseUrl }
149:         }
150:     }
151: };
152: 
153: builder.Services.AddReverseProxy()
154:     .LoadFromMemory(proxyRoutes, proxyClusters)
155:     .AddTransforms(context =>
156:     {
157:         context.AddRequestTransform(async transformContext =>
158:         {
159:             var httpContext = transformContext.HttpContext;
160:             var token = await httpContext.GetTokenAsync("access_token"); // Get token from cookie
161:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
162:             {
163:                 transformContext.ProxyRequest.Headers.Authorization =
164:                     new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token); // Attach as Bearer token
165:             }
166:         });
167:     });
168: ```
169: 
170: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**:
171: 
172: ```csharp
173: // File: Explore.Blazor/Program.cs
174: var exploreApiBaseUrl = builder.Configuration["ExploreApi:BaseUrl"] ?? "https://localhost:7039/";
175: 
176: var proxyRoutes = new[]
177: {
178:     new RouteConfig
179:     {
180:         RouteId = "explore-api",
181:         ClusterId = "explore-api",
182:         Match = new RouteMatch
183:         {
184:             Path = "/api/v1/{**catchall}"  // Catch all API routes
185:         }
186:     }
187: };
188: 
189: var proxyClusters = new[]
190: {
191:     new ClusterConfig
192:     {
193:         ClusterId = "explore-api",
194:         Destinations = new Dictionary<string, DestinationConfig>
195:         {
196:             ["primary"] = new() { Address = exploreApiBaseUrl }
197:         }
198:     }
199: };
200: 
201: builder.Services.AddReverseProxy()
202:     .LoadFromMemory(proxyRoutes, proxyClusters)
203:     .AddTransforms(context =>
204:     {
205:         context.AddRequestTransform(async transformContext =>
206:         {
207:             var httpContext = transformContext.HttpContext;
208:             var token = await httpContext.GetTokenAsync("access_token"); // Get token from cookie
209:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
210:             {
211:                 transformContext.ProxyRequest.Headers.Authorization =
212:                     new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token); // Attach as Bearer token
213:             }
214:         });
215:     });
216: ```
217: 
218: *For more details, see [bff-configuration.md](resources/bff-configuration.md).*
219: 
220: ### 2. Authentication Configuration (OIDC + Cookies)
221: 
222: **Purpose**: Configure OIDC authentication and cookie-based session management for the Blazor Server BFF.
223: 
224: **Generic Template** (works with any OIDC provider):
225: 
226: ```csharp
227: // File: {Project}.Blazor/Program.cs
228: builder.Services.AddAuthentication(options =>
229: {
230:     options.DefaultScheme = CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
231:     options.DefaultChallengeScheme = OpenIdConnectDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
232: })
233: .AddCookie(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme, options =>
234: {
235:     options.LoginPath = "/login";
236:     options.LogoutPath = "/logout";
237:     options.ExpireTimeSpan = TimeSpan.FromDays(7);
238:     options.SlidingExpiration = true;
239:     options.Cookie.HttpOnly = true;
240:     options.Cookie.SecurePolicy = CookieSecurePolicy.SameAsRequest;
241:     options.Cookie.SameSite = SameSiteMode.Lax;
242: })
243: .AddOpenIdConnect(options =>
244: {
245:     options.Authority = builder.Configuration["OIDC:Authority"];
246:     options.ClientId = builder.Configuration["OIDC:ClientId"];
247:     options.ClientSecret = builder.Configuration["OIDC:ClientSecret"];
248:     options.ResponseType = "code";
249:     options.UsePkce = true;
250:     options.SaveTokens = true;  // Store tokens in cookie
251:     options.GetClaimsFromUserInfoEndpoint = true;
252: 
253:     options.Scope.Clear();
254:     options.Scope.Add("openid");
255:     options.Scope.Add("profile");
256:     options.Scope.Add("email");
257:     options.Scope.Add("offline_access");  // Request refresh token
258: });
259: ```
260: 
261: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event** (uses Keycloak):
262: 
263: ```csharp
264: // File: Explore.Blazor/Program.cs
265: builder.Services.AddAuthentication(options =>
266: {
267:     options.DefaultScheme = CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
268:     options.DefaultChallengeScheme = OpenIdConnectDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
269: })
270: .AddCookie(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme, options =>
271: {
272:     options.LoginPath = "/login";
273:     options.LogoutPath = "/logout";
274:     options.ExpireTimeSpan = TimeSpan.FromDays(7);
275:     options.SlidingExpiration = true;
276:     options.Cookie.HttpOnly = true;
277:     options.Cookie.SecurePolicy = CookieSecurePolicy.SameAsRequest;
278:     options.Cookie.SameSite = SameSiteMode.Lax;
279: })
280: .AddOpenIdConnect(options =>
281: {
282:     options.Authority = builder.Configuration["Keycloak:Authority"];
283:     options.ClientId = builder.Configuration["Keycloak:ClientId"];
284:     options.ClientSecret = builder.Configuration["Keycloak:ClientSecret"];
285:     options.ResponseType = "code";
286:     options.UsePkce = true;
287:     options.SaveTokens = true;  // Store tokens in cookie
288:     options.GetClaimsFromUserInfoEndpoint = true;
289: 
290:     options.Scope.Clear();
291:     options.Scope.Add("openid");
292:     options.Scope.Add("profile");
293:     options.Scope.Add("email");
294:     options.Scope.Add("offline_access");  // Request refresh token
295: });
296: ```
297: 
298: *For more details, see [auth-state-management.md](resources/auth-state-management.md).*
299: 
300: ### 3. Token Forwarding for InteractiveServer Components
301: 
302: **Purpose**: In Blazor Hybrid apps, `HttpContext` is not always available in interactive components. Access tokens need to be explicitly forwarded to HTTP clients.
303: 
304: **Generic Template**:
305: 
306: ```csharp
307: // File: {Project}.Blazor/Services/CircuitAccessTokenService.cs (Scoped service)
308: public interface ICircuitAccessTokenService
309: {
310:     void SetAccessToken(string? token);
311:     string? GetAccessToken();
312: }
313: 
314: // File: {Project}.Blazor/Services/AccessTokenForwardingHandler.cs (DelegatingHandler)
315: public class AccessTokenForwardingHandler : DelegatingHandler
316: {
317:     private readonly ICircuitAccessTokenService _tokenService;
318:     public AccessTokenForwardingHandler(ICircuitAccessTokenService tokenService) => _tokenService = tokenService;
319:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
320:     {
321:         var token = _tokenService.GetAccessToken();
322:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
323:         {
324:             request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
325:         }
326:         return await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
327:     }
328: }
329: 
330: // Registration in Program.cs
331: builder.Services.AddScoped<ICircuitAccessTokenService, CircuitAccessTokenService>();
332: builder.Services.AddTransient<AccessTokenForwardingHandler>();
333: builder.Services.AddHttpClient<I{Entity}ApiClient, {Entity}ApiClient>(client =>
334: {
335:     client.BaseAddress = new Uri({project}ApiBaseUrl);
336: })
337: .AddHttpMessageHandler<AccessTokenForwardingHandler>();  // Attach token
338: ```
339: 
340: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**:
341: 
342: ```csharp
343: // File: Explore.Blazor/Services/CircuitAccessTokenService.cs (Scoped service)
344: public interface ICircuitAccessTokenService
345: {
346:     void SetAccessToken(string? token);
347:     string? GetAccessToken();
348: }
349: 
350: // File: Explore.Blazor/Services/AccessTokenForwardingHandler.cs (DelegatingHandler)
351: public class AccessTokenForwardingHandler : DelegatingHandler
352: {
353:     private readonly ICircuitAccessTokenService _tokenService;
354:     public AccessTokenForwardingHandler(ICircuitAccessTokenService tokenService) => _tokenService = tokenService;
355:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
356:     {
357:         var token = _tokenService.GetAccessToken();
358:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
359:         {
360:             request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
361:         }
362:         return await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
363:     }
364: }
365: 
366: // Registration in Program.cs
367: builder.Services.AddScoped<ICircuitAccessTokenService, CircuitAccessTokenService>();
368: builder.Services.AddTransient<AccessTokenForwardingHandler>();
369: builder.Services.AddHttpClient<IEventApiClient, EventApiClient>(client =>
370: {
371:     client.BaseAddress = new Uri(exploreApiBaseUrl);
372: })
373: .AddHttpMessageHandler<AccessTokenForwardingHandler>();  // Attach token
374: ```
375: 
376: *For more details, see [token-forwarding.md](resources/token-forwarding.md).*
377: 
378: ### 4. Service Layer Pattern
379: 
380: **Purpose**: Wrap NSwag-generated API clients with a service layer for error handling, logging, and providing safe defaults.
381: 
382: **Generic Template**:
383: 
384: ```csharp
385: // File: {Project}.Blazor.Client/Services/{Entity}Service.cs
386: public interface I{Entity}Service { /* ... */ }
387: 
388: public class {Entity}Service : I{Entity}Service
389: {
390:     private readonly I{Entity}ApiClient _apiClient; // NSwag-generated
391:     private readonly ILogger<{Entity}Service> _logger;
392: 
393:     public {Entity}Service(I{Entity}ApiClient apiClient, ILogger<{Entity}Service> logger) { /* ... */ }
394: 
395:     public async Task<ICollection<{Entity}ListDto>> GetAll{Entities}Async()
396:     {
397:         try
398:         {
399:             return await _apiClient.{Entity}AllAsync() ?? new List<{Entity}ListDto>();
400:         }
401:         catch (ApiException ex)
402:         {
403:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
404:             return new List<{Entity}ListDto>();  // Safe default
405:         }
406:     }
407: }
408: ```
409: 
410: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**:
411: 
412: ```csharp
413: // File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/EventService.cs
414: public interface IEventService { /* ... */ }
415: 
416: public class EventService : IEventService
417: {
418:     private readonly IEventApiClient _apiClient; // NSwag-generated
419:     private readonly ILogger<EventService> _logger;
420: 
421:     public EventService(IEventApiClient apiClient, ILogger<EventService> logger) { /* ... */ }
422: 
423:     public async Task<ICollection<EventListDto>> GetAllEventsAsync()
424:     {
425:         try
426:         {
427:             return await _apiClient.EventAllAsync() ?? new List<EventListDto>();
428:         }
429:         catch (ApiException ex)
430:         {
431:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
432:             return new List<EventListDto>();  // Safe default
433:         }
434:     }
435: }
436: ```
437: 
438: *For more details, see [service-layer-patterns.md](resources/service-layer-patterns.md).*
439: 
440: ## ✅ Do's
441: 
442: -   ✅ **DO** use YARP for API proxying (not custom middleware).
443: -   ✅ **DO** store tokens in server-side cookies (not `localStorage`).
444: -   ✅ **DO** forward Bearer token to API in YARP transform.
445: -   ✅ **DO** use a service layer to wrap API clients.
446: -   ✅ **DO** handle errors and return safe defaults in the service layer.
447: -   ✅ **DO** log API operations for debugging.
448: -   ✅ **DO** use `BrowserRequestCredentials.Include` for WASM requests.
449: -   ✅ **DO** redirect to login on `401 Unauthorized` responses.
450: -   ✅ **DO** serialize authentication state for WASM components.
451: 
452: ## ❌ Don'ts
453: 
454: -   ❌ **DON'T** expose tokens to the browser.
455: -   ❌ **DON'T** call API directly from WASM; always go through the BFF.
456: -   ❌ **DON'T** store sensitive data in `localStorage`.
457: -   ❌ **DON'T** bypass the service layer; use services, not API client directly.
458: -   ❌ **DON'T** forget CSRF protection (use antiforgery tokens).
459: -   ❌ **DON'T** hardcode API URLs; use configuration.
460: 
461: ---
462: 
463: **Related Documentation**:
464: - [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - Overall system architecture.
465: - [`auth-patterns`](../auth-patterns/SKILL.md) - Authentication and authorization patterns.
````

## File: .claude/skills/blazor-ui-conventions/resources/bem-methodology.md
````markdown
  1: # BEM Methodology - CSS Naming Conventions
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic BEM CSS Patterns**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: This document outlines the **BEM (Block, Element, Modifier)** methodology for naming CSS classes within Blazor applications. Adhering to BEM ensures maintainable, scalable, and understandable stylesheets, especially important in component-based UI frameworks like Blazor with MudBlazor.
  8: 
  9: ---
 10: 
 11: ## 1. What is BEM?
 12: 
 13: BEM stands for **Block**, **Element**, **Modifier**. It's a highly structured naming convention that helps you develop CSS that is modular, reusable, and easy to understand.
 14: 
 15: *   **Block (`.block`)**: A standalone entity that is meaningful on its own.
 16:     *   Examples: `.header`, `.footer`, `.menu`, `.button`, `.{entity}-card`, `.user-avatar`.
 17: *   **Element (`.block__element`)**: A part of a block that has no standalone meaning and is semantically tied to its block.
 18:     *   Examples: `.menu__item`, `.button__icon`, `.{entity}-card__title`, `.user-avatar__image`.
 19: *   **Modifier (`.block--modifier` or `.block__element--modifier`)**: A flag on a block or an element. It's used to change the appearance, behavior, or state of a block or element.
 20:     *   Examples: `.button--primary`, `.button--disabled`, `.{entity}-card--featured`, `.menu__item--active`.
 21: 
 22: ### Naming Syntax
 23: 
 24: *   **Block**: `block-name`
 25: *   **Element**: `block-name__element-name` (two underscores)
 26: *   **Modifier**: `block-name--modifier-name` (two hyphens) or `block-name__element-name--modifier-name`
 27: 
 28: ---
 29: 
 30: ## 2. Why BEM?
 31: 
 32: *   **Modularity**: Encapsulated styles. Styles for a block never affect other blocks.
 33: *   **Reusability**: Blocks and elements can be reused across different parts of the application.
 34: *   **Maintainability**: Easy to understand what a CSS rule does, where it applies, and how it relates to other components. New features are less likely to break existing styles.
 35: *   **Scalability**: Well-suited for large projects and teams.
 36: *   **Specificity Management**: Keeps CSS specificity low and flat, reducing the need for `!important` and making overrides predictable.
 37: 
 38: ---
 39: 
 40: ## 3. BEM in Blazor with MudBlazor
 41: 
 42: When working with Blazor and MudBlazor, BEM is used for custom styling that goes beyond MudBlazor's theming and utility classes.
 43: 
 44: ### Example: Custom {Entity} Card
 45: 
 46: Let's say we have an {entity} card component with custom styling that extends MudBlazor's `MudCard`.
 47: 
 48: **`{Entity}Card.razor`**:
 49: ```razor
 50: <MudCard Class="{entity}-card @(_isFeatured ? "{entity}-card--featured" : "")">
 51:     <MudCardMedia Image="@{Entity}.ImageUrl" Height="200" Class="{entity}-card__image" />
 52:     <MudCardContent>
 53:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="{entity}-card__title">@{Entity}.Title</MudText>
 54:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="{entity}-card__date">@{Entity}.Date.ToShortDateString()</MudText>
 55:     </MudCardContent>
 56:     <MudCardActions Class="{entity}-card__actions">
 57:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" OnClick="ViewDetails" Class="{entity}-card__button">
 58:             View Details
 59:         </MudButton>
 60:     </MudCardActions>
 61: </MudCard>
 62: 
 63: @code {
 64:     [Parameter] public {Entity}Dto {Entity} { get; set; } = null!;
 65:     [Parameter] public bool IsFeatured { get; set; }
 66: 
 67:     private bool _isFeatured => IsFeatured; // Use local state for conditional classes
 68:     // ...
 69: }
 70: ```
 71: 
 72: **`{Entity}Card.razor.css`** (scoped CSS for the component):
 73: ```css
 74: /* Block: .{entity}-card */
 75: .{entity}-card {
 76:     border: 1px solid var(--mud-palette-lines-default);
 77:     border-radius: var(--mud-default-border-radius);
 78:     box-shadow: var(--mud-shadow-1);
 79:     transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
 80: }
 81: 
 82: .{entity}-card:hover {
 83:     box-shadow: var(--mud-shadow-3);
 84:     transform: translateY(-2px);
 85: }
 86: 
 87: /* Element: .{entity}-card__image */
 88: .{entity}-card__image {
 89:     object-fit: cover;
 90: }
 91: 
 92: /* Element: .{entity}-card__title */
 93: .{entity}-card__title {
 94:     font-weight: 600;
 95:     margin-bottom: 8px;
 96:     /* Using MudBlazor's CSS variables for theme integration */
 97:     color: var(--mud-palette-text-primary);
 98: }
 99: 
100: /* Element: .{entity}-card__date */
101: .{entity}-card__date {
102:     font-size: 0.875rem;
103:     color: var(--mud-palette-text-secondary);
104: }
105: 
106: /* Element: .{entity}-card__actions */
107: .{entity}-card__actions {
108:     padding: 8px 16px;
109:     justify-content: flex-end;
110: }
111: 
112: /* Element: .{entity}-card__button */
113: /* Note: MudButton already provides extensive styling, this is for subtle overrides */
114: .{entity}-card__button {
115:     text-transform: uppercase;
116: }
117: 
118: /* Modifier: .{entity}-card--featured */
119: .{entity}-card--featured {
120:     border-color: var(--mud-palette-primary); /* Highlight featured items */
121:     box-shadow: var(--mud-shadow-6);
122: }
123: 
124: .{entity}-card--featured .{entity}-card__title {
125:     color: var(--mud-palette-primary-text); /* Ensure good contrast */
126: }
127: ```
128: 
129: ### Best Practices for BEM with Blazor Scoped CSS:
130: 
131: *   **Scoped CSS (`.razor.css`)**: Always use Blazor's scoped CSS feature for component-specific styles. This helps prevent conflicts and automatically applies unique identifiers to your CSS rules.
132: *   **Deep Selectors (`::deep`, `::part`)**: Use `::deep` or `::part` when you need to style elements *inside* a MudBlazor component's shadow DOM or internal structure.
133:     ```css
134:     /* Example: Styling the text input within a MudTextField */
135:     .my-form-field ::deep .mud-input-control-input {
136:         color: var(--mud-palette-info);
137:     }
138:     ```
139:     *Note*: `::deep` is a deprecated combinator for shadow DOM piercing. While it works in Blazor scoped CSS today, `::part` is the web standard for styling parts of web components. MudBlazor may not expose many `::part`s currently, but it's good to be aware.
140: *   **MudBlazor Utility Classes**: Leverage MudBlazor's utility classes (`mb-4`, `pa-2`, `d-flex`, `justify-center`) for common spacing, padding, and flexbox layouts before resorting to custom BEM classes.
141: *   **CSS Variables**: Use MudBlazor's CSS variables (e.g., `var(--mud-palette-primary)`, `var(--mud-typography-h6-size)`) to integrate seamlessly with the application's theming system.
142: *   **Minimal Overrides**: Avoid overly broad overrides of MudBlazor's core classes. If a component doesn't offer enough customization, apply BEM classes to a wrapper or directly to the component for targeted styling.
143: 
144: ---
145: 
146: ## 4. Common BEM Mistakes to Avoid
147: 
148: *   **Over-nesting**: Keep selectors flat. Avoid deeply nested CSS rules.
149:     ```css
150:     /* BAD */
151:     .{entity}-card .{entity}-card__content .{entity}-card__title {
152:         /* ... */
153:     }
154: 
155:     /* GOOD */
156:     .{entity}-card__title {
157:         /* ... */
158:     }
159:     ```
160: *   **Block Modifiers on Elements**: Modifiers should describe the state of the *block* or *element* they are attached to, not another block's element.
161:     ```html
162:     <!-- BAD -->
163:     <div class="{entity}-card">
164:         <h2 class="{entity}-card__title {entity}-card--featured">{Entity} Title</h2>
165:     </div>
166: 
167:     <!-- GOOD -->
168:     <div class="{entity}-card {entity}-card--featured">
169:         <h2 class="{entity}-card__title">{Entity} Title</h2>
170:     </div>
171:     ```
172: *   **Semantic Overload**: A block should be a standalone entity. Don't make an element also a block.
173:     ```html
174:     <!-- BAD -->
175:     <div class="{entity}-card">
176:         <div class="title-block">{Entity} Title</div>
177:     </div>
178: 
179:     <!-- GOOD -->
180:     <div class="{entity}-card">
181:         <h2 class="{entity}-card__title">{Entity} Title</h2>
182:     </div>
183:     ```
184: 
185: ---
186: 
187: ## 5. Integrating BEM with Global Styles
188: 
189: While scoped CSS is preferred, some BEM blocks might need global definitions or overrides that affect multiple components. These should be placed in `wwwroot/css/site.css` or `wwwroot/css/app.css`.
190: 
191: **`wwwroot/css/site.css`**:
192: ```css
193: /* Global BEM Block example */
194: .layout-header {
195:     background-color: var(--mud-palette-background-grey);
196:     padding: 16px;
197: }
198: 
199: .layout-header__logo {
200:     font-size: 1.5rem;
201:     font-weight: bold;
202: }
203: ```
204: 
205: ---
206: 
207: **Related Resources**:
208: - [theming.md](theming.md) - How CSS variables and MudBlazor theme work together.
209: - [mudblazor-usage.md](mudblazor-usage.md) - For how to apply these styles to specific MudBlazor components.
````

## File: .claude/skills/blazor-ui-conventions/resources/common-patterns.md
````markdown
   1: # Common Blazor UI Patterns
   2: 
   3: > **Project-Agnostic UI Implementation Patterns**
   4: >
   5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
   6: 
   7: This document describes frequently used UI implementation patterns in Blazor applications, covering forms, dialogs, tables, navigation, loading states, error handling, search/filter functionalities, and infinite scroll. These patterns ensure consistency, reusability, and maintainability across the user interface.
   8: 
   9: ---
  10: 
  11: ## 1. Form Patterns
  12: 
  13: Forms are central to data input. They are typically built using MudBlazor components and integrated with validation.
  14: 
  15: ### Basic Form with MudBlazor Components
  16: 
  17: ```razor
  18: @inject IMediator Mediator
  19: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
  20: @inject NavigationManager NavigationManager
  21: 
  22: <MudCard>
  23:     <MudCardHeader>
  24:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5">Create New {Entity}</MudText>
  25:     </MudCardHeader>
  26:     <MudCardContent>
  27:         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_dto.Title"
  28:                       Label="{Entity} Title"
  29:                       Required="true"
  30:                       RequiredError="Title is required"
  31:                       MaxLength="200"
  32:                       Class="mb-4" />
  33: 
  34:         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_dto.Description"
  35:                       Label="Description"
  36:                       Lines="5"
  37:                       MaxLength="500"
  38:                       Counter="500"
  39:                       Class="mb-4" />
  40: 
  41:         <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="_startDate"
  42:                        Label="Start Date"
  43:                        Required="true"
  44:                        MinDate="DateTime.Today"
  45:                        Class="mb-4" />
  46: 
  47:         <MudSelect @bind-Value="_dto.{LookupEntity}Id"
  48:                    Label="{LookupEntity}"
  49:                    Required="true"
  50:                    RequiredError="{LookupEntity} is required"
  51:                    Class="mb-4">
  52:             @foreach (var item in _{lookupEntities})
  53:             {
  54:                 <MudSelectItem Value="@item.Id">@item.FullName</MudSelectItem>
  55:             }
  56:         </MudSelect>
  57:     </MudCardContent>
  58:     <MudCardActions Class="d-flex justify-end">
  59:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel" Variant="Variant.Text">Cancel</MudButton>
  60:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
  61:                    Color="Color.Primary"
  62:                    OnClick="Submit"
  63:                    Disabled="_isSubmitting"
  64:                    Class="ml-2">
  65:             @if (_isSubmitting)
  66:             {
  67:                 <MudProgressCircular Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" Class="mr-2" />
  68:                 <MudText>Creating...</MudText>
  69:             }
  70:             else
  71:             {
  72:                 <text>Create {Entity}</text>
  73:             }
  74:         </MudButton>
  75:     </MudCardActions>
  76: </MudCard>
  77: 
  78: @code {
  79:     private Create{Entity}Dto _dto = new();
  80:     private DateTime? _startDate;
  81:     private bool _isSubmitting;
  82:     private List<{LookupEntity}Dto> _{lookupEntities} = new();
  83: 
  84:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
  85:     {
  86:         // Load dropdown data
  87:         // _{lookupEntities} = await Mediator.Send(new Get{LookupEntity}ListRequest());
  88:     }
  89: 
  90:     private async Task Submit()
  91:     {
  92:         // Basic client-side validation check
  93:         if (!_startDate.HasValue)
  94:         {
  95:             Snackbar.Add("Start date is required", Severity.Error);
  96:             return;
  97:         }
  98: 
  99:         _dto.FirstSessionDate = DateOnly.FromDateTime(_startDate.Value);
 100:         _isSubmitting = true;
 101: 
 102:         try
 103:         {
 104:             var command = new Create{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = _dto };
 105:             var result = await Mediator.Send(command);
 106: 
 107:             if (result.Success)
 108:             {
 109:                 Snackbar.Add("{Entity} created successfully", Severity.Success);
 110:                 NavigationManager.NavigateTo($"/{entities}/{result.Id}");
 111:             }
 112:             else
 113:             {
 114:                 foreach (var error in result.Errors)
 115:                 {
 116:                     Snackbar.Add(error, Severity.Error);
 117:                 }
 118:             }
 119:         }
 120:         catch (Exception ex)
 121:         {
 122:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error creating {entity}.");
 123:             Snackbar.Add("An unexpected error occurred.", Severity.Error);
 124:         }
 125:         finally
 126:         {
 127:             _isSubmitting = false;
 128:         }
 129:     }
 130: 
 131:     private void Cancel()
 132:     {
 133:         NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/{entities}");
 134:     }
 135: }
 136: ```
 137: 
 138: ### Form with FluentValidation Integration
 139: 
 140: For more complex validation rules, especially those involving cross-field or asynchronous checks, FluentValidation is integrated with Blazor's `EditForm`.
 141: 
 142: ```razor
 143: @using FluentValidation
 144: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms
 145: 
 146: <EditForm Model="@_dto" OnValidSubmit="HandleValidSubmit" OnInvalidSubmit="HandleInvalidSubmit">
 147:     <FluentValidationValidator @ref="_validator" />
 148:     <ValidationSummary />
 149: 
 150:     <MudCard>
 151:         <MudCardContent>
 152:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="_dto.Title"
 153:                           For="@(() => _dto.Title)"
 154:                           Label="{Entity} Title"
 155:                           Immediate="true" />
 156: 
 157:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="_dto.Email"
 158:                           For="@(() => _dto.Email)"
 159:                           Label="Contact Email"
 160:                           Immediate="true" />
 161:         </MudCardContent>
 162:         <MudCardActions>
 163:             <MudButton ButtonType="ButtonType.Submit"
 164:                        Variant="Variant.Filled"
 165:                        Color="Color.Primary">
 166:                 Submit
 167:             </MudButton>
 168:         </MudCardActions>
 169:     </MudCard>
 170: </EditForm>
 171: 
 172: @code {
 173:     private Create{Entity}Dto _dto = new();
 174:     private FluentValidationValidator? _validator;
 175: 
 176:     private async Task HandleValidSubmit()
 177:     {
 178:         var command = new Create{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = _dto };
 179:         await Mediator.Send(command);
 180:         Snackbar.Add("Form submitted successfully!", Severity.Success);
 181:     }
 182: 
 183:     private void HandleInvalidSubmit()
 184:     {
 185:         Snackbar.Add("Please correct the form errors.", Severity.Error);
 186:     }
 187: }
 188: ```
 189: 
 190: ---
 191: 
 192: ## 2. Dialog Patterns
 193: 
 194: MudDialog is used for modal interactions, from simple confirmations to complex data entry forms.
 195: 
 196: ### Confirmation Dialog (`ConfirmDialog.razor`)
 197: 
 198: A reusable component for displaying a confirmation message with customizable text and button styling.
 199: 
 200: ```razor
 201: @* ConfirmDialog.razor *@
 202: <MudDialog>
 203:     <DialogContent>
 204:         <MudText>@ContentText</MudText>
 205:     </DialogContent>
 206:     <DialogActions>
 207:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
 208:         <MudButton Color="@Color"
 209:                    Variant="Variant.Filled"
 210:                    OnClick="Submit">
 211:             @ButtonText
 212:         </MudButton>
 213:     </DialogActions>
 214: </MudDialog>
 215: 
 216: @code {
 217:     [CascadingParameter]
 218:     private MudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
 219: 
 220:     [Parameter]
 221:     public string ContentText { get; set; } = "Are you sure?";
 222: 
 223:     [Parameter]
 224:     public string ButtonText { get; set; } = "OK";
 225: 
 226:     [Parameter]
 227:     public Color Color { get; set; } = Color.Primary;
 228: 
 229:     private void Submit() => MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
 230:     private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
 231: }
 232: ```
 233: 
 234: **Usage (Opening the Dialog)**:
 235: ```razor
 236: @inject IDialogService DialogService
 237: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 238: 
 239: <MudButton OnClick="Delete{Entity}">Delete {Entity}</MudButton>
 240: 
 241: @code {
 242:     private async Task Delete{Entity}()
 243:     {
 244:         var parameters = new DialogParameters
 245:         {
 246:             ["ContentText"] = "Are you sure you want to delete this {entity}? This action cannot be undone.",
 247:             ["ButtonText"] = "Delete",
 248:             ["Color"] = Color.Error
 249:         };
 250: 
 251:         var dialogOptions = new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.ExtraSmall, FullWidth = true };
 252: 
 253:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<ConfirmDialog>(
 254:             "Confirm Deletion",
 255:             parameters,
 256:             dialogOptions);
 257: 
 258:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 259: 
 260:         if (!result.Canceled && (bool)(result.Data ?? false))
 261:         {
 262:             Snackbar.Add("{Entity} deleted successfully", Severity.Success);
 263:             // ... Call backend to delete ...
 264:         }
 265:         else
 266:         {
 267:             Snackbar.Add("Deletion cancelled", Severity.Info);
 268:         }
 269:     }
 270: }
 271: ```
 272: 
 273: ### Form Dialog (`Create{Entity}Dialog.razor`)
 274: 
 275: Embedding a form within a dialog for data input.
 276: 
 277: ```razor
 278: @* Create{Entity}Dialog.razor *@
 279: @inject IMediator Mediator
 280: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 281: 
 282: <MudDialog>
 283:     <TitleContent>
 284:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Create New {Entity}</MudText>
 285:     </TitleContent>
 286:     <DialogContent>
 287:         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_dto.Title"
 288:                       Label="{Entity} Title"
 289:                       Required="true" />
 290:         <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="_startDate"
 291:                        Label="Start Date"
 292:                        MinDate="DateTime.Today" />
 293:         @* ... other form fields ... *@
 294:     </DialogContent>
 295:     <DialogActions>
 296:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
 297:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary"
 298:                    Variant="Variant.Filled"
 299:                    OnClick="Submit"
 300:                    Disabled="_isSubmitting">
 301:             Create
 302:         </MudButton>
 303:     </DialogActions>
 304: </MudDialog>
 305: 
 306: @code {
 307:     [CascadingParameter]
 308:     private MudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
 309: 
 310:     private Create{Entity}Dto _dto = new();
 311:     private DateTime? _startDate;
 312:     private bool _isSubmitting;
 313: 
 314:     private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
 315: 
 316:     private async Task Submit()
 317:     {
 318:         if (!_startDate.HasValue) { Snackbar.Add("Start date is required", Severity.Error); return; }
 319:         _dto.FirstSessionDate = DateOnly.FromDateTime(_startDate.Value);
 320:         _isSubmitting = true;
 321: 
 322:         try
 323:         {
 324:             var command = new Create{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = _dto };
 325:             var result = await Mediator.Send(command);
 326: 
 327:             if (result.Success)
 328:             {
 329:                 Snackbar.Add("{Entity} created successfully", Severity.Success);
 330:                 MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(result.Id)); // ✅ Close with the new entity ID
 331:             }
 332:             else
 333:             {
 334:                 foreach (var error in result.Errors) Snackbar.Add(error, Severity.Error);
 335:             }
 336:         }
 337:         finally { _isSubmitting = false; }
 338:     }
 339: }
 340: ```
 341: 
 342: ---
 343: 
 344: ## 3. Table Patterns
 345: 
 346: `MudTable` is the primary component for displaying tabular data, offering features like sorting, pagination, and filtering.
 347: 
 348: ### CRUD Table
 349: 
 350: A common pattern for displaying a list of entities with actions for viewing, editing, and deleting.
 351: 
 352: ```razor
 353: @inject IMediator Mediator
 354: @inject IDialogService DialogService
 355: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 356: @inject NavigationManager NavigationManager
 357: 
 358: <MudTable Items="@_{entities}" Hover="true" Loading="@_isLoading" LoadingProgressColor="Color.Info">
 359:     <ToolBarContent>
 360:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">{Entities} List</MudText>
 361:         <MudSpacer />
 362:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 363:                    Color="Color.Primary"
 364:                    StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
 365:                    OnClick="CreateNew{Entity}">
 366:             Create {Entity}
 367:         </MudButton>
 368:     </ToolBarContent>
 369:     <HeaderContent>
 370:         <MudTh>Title</MudTh>
 371:         <MudTh>Date</MudTh>
 372:         <MudTh>Location</MudTh>
 373:         <MudTh>Status</MudTh>
 374:         <MudTh Style="width: 150px">Actions</MudTh>
 375:     </HeaderContent>
 376:     <RowTemplate>
 377:         <MudTd DataLabel="Title">@context.Title</MudTd>
 378:         <MudTd DataLabel="Date">@context.FirstSessionDate?.ToShortDateString()</MudTd>
 379:         <MudTd DataLabel="Location">@context.LocationFullName</MudTd>
 380:         <MudTd DataLabel="Status">
 381:             <MudChip Size="Size.Small"
 382:                      Color="@GetStatusColor(context.StatusFullName)">
 383:                 @context.StatusFullName
 384:             </MudChip>
 385:         </MudTd>
 386:         <MudTd DataLabel="Actions">
 387:             <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Visibility"
 388:                            Size="Size.Small"
 389:                            OnClick="@(() => View{Entity}(context.Id))" />
 390:             <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
 391:                            Size="Size.Small"
 392:                            Color="Color.Primary"
 393:                            OnClick="@(() => Edit{Entity}(context.Id))" />
 394:             <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
 395:                            Size="Size.Small"
 396:                            Color="Color.Error"
 397:                            OnClick="@(() => Delete{Entity}(context.Id))" />
 398:         </MudTd>
 399:     </RowTemplate>
 400:     <PagerContent>
 401:         <MudTablePager />
 402:     </PagerContent>
 403: </MudTable>
 404: 
 405: @code {
 406:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> _{entities} = new();
 407:     private bool _isLoading;
 408: 
 409:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 410:     {
 411:         await Load{Entities}();
 412:     }
 413: 
 414:     private async Task Load{Entities}()
 415:     {
 416:         _isLoading = true;
 417:         try
 418:         {
 419:             _{entities} = await Mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}ListRequest());
 420:         }
 421:         catch (Exception ex)
 422:         {
 423:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load {entities}.");
 424:             Snackbar.Add("Failed to load {entities}.", Severity.Error);
 425:         }
 426:         finally
 427:         {
 428:             _isLoading = false;
 429:         }
 430:     }
 431: 
 432:     private Color GetStatusColor(string status) => status switch
 433:     {
 434:         "Published" => Color.Success,
 435:         "Draft" => Color.Warning,
 436:         "Cancelled" => Color.Error,
 437:         _ => Color.Default
 438:     };
 439: 
 440:     private async Task CreateNew{Entity}()
 441:     {
 442:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<Create{Entity}Dialog>("Create {Entity}");
 443:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 444: 
 445:         if (!result.Canceled && result.Data is {IdType} {entity}Id)
 446:         {
 447:             Snackbar.Add($"{Entity} created with ID: {{entity}Id}", Severity.Success);
 448:             await Load{Entities}();
 449:         }
 450:     }
 451: 
 452:     private void View{Entity}({IdType} id) => NavigationManager.NavigateTo($"/{entities}/{id}");
 453:     private void Edit{Entity}({IdType} id) => NavigationManager.NavigateTo($"/{entities}/{id}/edit");
 454: 
 455:     private async Task Delete{Entity}({IdType} id)
 456:     {
 457:         var parameters = new DialogParameters
 458:         {
 459:             ["ContentText"] = "Are you sure you want to delete this {entity}? This action is irreversible.",
 460:             ["ButtonText"] = "Delete",
 461:             ["Color"] = Color.Error
 462:         };
 463: 
 464:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<ConfirmDialog>("Confirm Deletion", parameters);
 465:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 466: 
 467:         if (!result.Canceled && (bool)(result.Data ?? false))
 468:         {
 469:             var deleteCommand = new Delete{Entity}Command { Id = id };
 470:             var deleteResult = await Mediator.Send(deleteCommand);
 471: 
 472:             if (deleteResult)
 473:             {
 474:                 Snackbar.Add("{Entity} deleted successfully", Severity.Success);
 475:                 await Load{Entities}();
 476:             }
 477:             else
 478:             {
 479:                 Snackbar.Add("Failed to delete {entity}.", Severity.Error);
 480:             }
 481:         }
 482:     }
 483: }
 484: ```
 485: 
 486: ---
 487: 
 488: ## 4. Navigation Patterns
 489: 
 490: ### Programmatic Navigation
 491: 
 492: Using `NavigationManager` for dynamic page routing.
 493: 
 494: ```razor
 495: @inject NavigationManager NavigationManager
 496: 
 497: @code {
 498:     private void NavigateTo{Entity}Details({IdType} {entity}Id)
 499:     {
 500:         NavigationManager.NavigateTo($"/{entities}/{{entity}Id}");
 501:     }
 502: 
 503:     private void NavigateTo{Entities}List()
 504:     {
 505:         NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/{entities}");
 506:     }
 507: 
 508:     private void OpenExternalLink(string url)
 509:     {
 510:         NavigationManager.NavigateTo(url, forceLoad: true);
 511:     }
 512: }
 513: ```
 514: 
 515: ### Navigation with Query Parameters
 516: 
 517: For filtering, sorting, or complex state that needs to be reflected in the URL.
 518: 
 519: ```razor
 520: @inject NavigationManager NavigationManager
 521: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.WebUtilities
 522: 
 523: @code {
 524:     private {IdType}? _{parentEntity}IdFilter;
 525:     private {LookupIdType}? _{lookupEntity}Filter;
 526: 
 527:     protected override void OnInitialized()
 528:     {
 529:         var uri = new Uri(NavigationManager.Uri);
 530:         var query = QueryHelpers.ParseQuery(uri.Query);
 531: 
 532:         if (query.TryGetValue("{parentEntity}Id", out var parentIdValue) && {IdType}.TryParse(parentIdValue, out var parsedParentId))
 533:         {
 534:             _{parentEntity}IdFilter = parsedParentId;
 535:         }
 536:         if (query.TryGetValue("{lookupEntity}Id", out var lookupValue) && {LookupIdType}.TryParse(lookupValue, out var parsedLookup))
 537:         {
 538:             _{lookupEntity}Filter = parsedLookup;
 539:         }
 540:     }
 541: 
 542:     private void ApplyFiltersAndNavigate()
 543:     {
 544:         var queryParams = new Dictionary<string, object?>
 545:         {
 546:             ["{parentEntity}Id"] = _{parentEntity}IdFilter,
 547:             ["{lookupEntity}Id"] = _{lookupEntity}Filter,
 548:             ["page"] = 1
 549:         };
 550: 
 551:         var uri = NavigationManager.GetUriWithQueryParameters(queryParams);
 552:         NavigationManager.NavigateTo(uri);
 553:     }
 554: }
 555: ```
 556: 
 557: ---
 558: 
 559: ## 5. Loading State Patterns
 560: 
 561: Providing visual feedback during data loading is crucial for good UX.
 562: 
 563: ### Simple Loading Indicator
 564: 
 565: ```razor
 566: @if (_isLoading)
 567: {
 568:     <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Color="Color.Primary" />
 569:     <MudText Class="ml-2">Loading {entities}...</MudText>
 570: }
 571: else if (_{entities}.Any())
 572: {
 573:     @* Display {entities} *@
 574: }
 575: else
 576: {
 577:     <MudText>No {entities} found matching your criteria.</MudText>
 578: }
 579: 
 580: @code {
 581:     private bool _isLoading;
 582:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> _{entities} = new();
 583: }
 584: ```
 585: 
 586: ### Skeleton Loading
 587: 
 588: Mimics the layout of the content that is about to be loaded, providing a better perceived performance.
 589: 
 590: ```razor
 591: @if (_isLoading)
 592: {
 593:     <MudGrid>
 594:         @for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
 595:         {
 596:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4" lg="3">
 597:                 <MudCard Elevation="1">
 598:                     <MudSkeleton SkeletonType="SkeletonType.Rectangle" Height="200px" Animation="Animation.Pulse" />
 599:                     <MudCardContent>
 600:                         <MudSkeleton Width="80%" Height="30px" />
 601:                         <MudSkeleton Width="60%" Height="20px" Class="mt-2" />
 602:                     </MudCardContent>
 603:                 </MudCard>
 604:             </MudItem>
 605:         }
 606:     </MudGrid>
 607: }
 608: else
 609: {
 610:     @* Actual {entity} cards *@
 611: }
 612: ```
 613: 
 614: ### Progress Overlay
 615: 
 616: Useful for full-screen loading or when waiting for an action to complete.
 617: 
 618: ```razor
 619: <MudOverlay Visible="_isLoading" DarkBackground="true" Absolute="true" ZIndex="MudBlazor.Defaults.ZIndex.Snackbar">
 620:     <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Large" />
 621: </MudOverlay>
 622: 
 623: <MudContainer>
 624:     @* Page content here, will be overlaid when loading *@
 625: </MudContainer>
 626: 
 627: @code {
 628:     private bool _isLoading;
 629: }
 630: ```
 631: 
 632: ---
 633: 
 634: ## 6. Error Handling Patterns
 635: 
 636: Robust error handling improves user experience and helps with debugging.
 637: 
 638: ### Try-Catch with User Feedback
 639: 
 640: Wrap API calls or critical operations in `try-catch` blocks to handle exceptions gracefully and provide feedback to the user via `ISnackbar`.
 641: 
 642: ```razor
 643: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 644: @inject ILogger<MyComponent> _logger
 645: 
 646: @code {
 647:     private async Task LoadData()
 648:     {
 649:         _isLoading = true;
 650:         try
 651:         {
 652:             _{entities} = await Mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}ListRequest());
 653:         }
 654:         catch (HttpRequestException ex)
 655:         {
 656:             _logger.LogError(ex, "HTTP Request failed during {entity} load.");
 657:             Snackbar.Add("Network error. Please check your connection or try again.", Severity.Error);
 658:         }
 659:         catch (Exception ex)
 660:         {
 661:             _logger.LogError(ex, "An unexpected error occurred during {entity} load.");
 662:             Snackbar.Add("An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.", Severity.Error);
 663:         }
 664:         finally
 665:         {
 666:             _isLoading = false;
 667:         }
 668:     }
 669: }
 670: ```
 671: 
 672: ### Blazor `ErrorBoundary` Component
 673: 
 674: The `ErrorBoundary` component catches unhandled exceptions in its child content and renders fallback UI.
 675: 
 676: ```razor
 677: <ErrorBoundary>
 678:     <ChildContent>
 679:         <{Entity}List />
 680:     </ChildContent>
 681:     <ErrorContent Context="exception">
 682:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mt-4">
 683:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Something went wrong!</MudText>
 684:             <MudText>An error occurred while rendering the {entity} list.</MudText>
 685:             <MudText Class="mt-2">Error details: @exception.Message</MudText>
 686:             <MudButton OnClick="@(() => exception.Recover())" Color="Color.Warning" Class="mt-3">
 687:                 Try Again
 688:             </MudButton>
 689:         </MudAlert>
 690:     </ErrorContent>
 691: </ErrorBoundary>
 692: ```
 693: 
 694: ### Backend Command Result Handling
 695: 
 696: For command (write) operations, the backend returns a `BaseCommandResponse` which contains `Success`, `Message`, `Id`, and a list of `Errors`. This allows for structured error reporting.
 697: 
 698: ```razor
 699: @code {
 700:     private async Task CreateNew{Entity}()
 701:     {
 702:         var command = new Create{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = _dto };
 703:         var result = await Mediator.Send(command);
 704: 
 705:         if (result.Success)
 706:         {
 707:             Snackbar.Add("{Entity} created successfully", Severity.Success);
 708:             NavigationManager.NavigateTo($"/{entities}/{result.Id}");
 709:         }
 710:         else
 711:         {
 712:             foreach (var error in result.Errors)
 713:             {
 714:                 Snackbar.Add(error, Severity.Error);
 715:             }
 716:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(result.Message))
 717:             {
 718:                 Snackbar.Add(result.Message, Severity.Warning);
 719:             }
 720:         }
 721:     }
 722: }
 723: ```
 724: 
 725: ---
 726: 
 727: ## 7. Search and Filter Patterns
 728: 
 729: Providing intuitive ways for users to find and narrow down data.
 730: 
 731: ### Debounced Search Input
 732: 
 733: Prevents excessive updates or API calls by waiting for a pause in user typing.
 734: 
 735: ```razor
 736: <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchTerm"
 737:               Label="Search {Entities}"
 738:               Immediate="true"
 739:               DebounceInterval="300"
 740:               OnDebounceIntervalElapsed="OnSearch"
 741:               Adornment="Adornment.End"
 742:               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search" />
 743: 
 744: <MudGrid>
 745:     @foreach (var item in _filtered{Entities})
 746:     {
 747:         <MudItem xs="12" md="6" lg="4">
 748:             <{Entity}Card {Entity}="@item" />
 749:         </MudItem>
 750:     }
 751: </MudGrid>
 752: 
 753: @code {
 754:     private string _searchTerm = string.Empty;
 755:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> _{entities} = new();
 756:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> _filtered{Entities} = new();
 757: 
 758:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 759:     {
 760:         _{entities} = await Mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}ListRequest());
 761:         _filtered{Entities} = _{entities};
 762:     }
 763: 
 764:     private void OnSearch()
 765:     {
 766:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchTerm))
 767:         {
 768:             _filtered{Entities} = _{entities};
 769:         }
 770:         else
 771:         {
 772:             _filtered{Entities} = _{entities}
 773:                 .Where(e => e.Title.Contains(_searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
 774:                            (e.Description?.Contains(_searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false))
 775:                 .ToList();
 776:         }
 777:     }
 778: }
 779: ```
 780: 
 781: ### Filter Panel
 782: 
 783: A dedicated section for applying multiple filter criteria.
 784: 
 785: ```razor
 786: <MudGrid>
 787:     <MudItem xs="12" md="3">
 788:         <MudPaper Class="pa-4">
 789:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-4">Filters</MudText>
 790: 
 791:             <MudSelect @bind-Value="_filters.{ParentEntity}Id"
 792:                        Label="{ParentEntity}"
 793:                        Clearable="true"
 794:                        OnClearButtonClick="Clear{ParentEntity}"
 795:                        Class="mb-3">
 796:                 @foreach (var item in _{parentEntities})
 797:                 {
 798:                     <MudSelectItem Value="@item.Id">@item.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 799:                 }
 800:             </MudSelect>
 801: 
 802:             <MudSelect @bind-Value="_filters.{LookupEntity}Id"
 803:                        Label="{LookupEntity}"
 804:                        Clearable="true"
 805:                        Class="mb-4">
 806:                 @foreach (var item in _{lookupEntities})
 807:                 {
 808:                     <MudSelectItem Value="@item.Id">@item.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 809:                 }
 810:             </MudSelect>
 811: 
 812:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 813:                        Color="Color.Primary"
 814:                        FullWidth="true"
 815:                        OnClick="ApplyFilters"
 816:                        Class="mb-2">
 817:                 Apply Filters
 818:             </MudButton>
 819: 
 820:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
 821:                        FullWidth="true"
 822:                        OnClick="ClearAllFilters">
 823:                 Clear All
 824:             </MudButton>
 825:         </MudPaper>
 826:     </MudItem>
 827: 
 828:     <MudItem xs="12" md="9">
 829:         <MudGrid>
 830:             @foreach (var item in _filtered{Entities})
 831:             {
 832:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" lg="4">
 833:                     <{Entity}Card {Entity}="@item" />
 834:                 </MudItem>
 835:             }
 836:         </MudGrid>
 837:     </MudItem>
 838: </MudGrid>
 839: 
 840: @code {
 841:     private {Entity}FilterDto _filters = new();
 842:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> _filtered{Entities} = new();
 843:     private List<{ParentEntity}Dto> _{parentEntities} = new();
 844:     private List<{LookupEntity}Dto> _{lookupEntities} = new();
 845: 
 846:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 847:     {
 848:         await LoadFilterOptions();
 849:         await ApplyFilters();
 850:     }
 851: 
 852:     private async Task LoadFilterOptions() { /* ... */ }
 853: 
 854:     private async Task ApplyFilters()
 855:     {
 856:         var request = new Get{Entity}ListRequest
 857:         {
 858:             {ParentEntity}Id = _filters.{ParentEntity}Id,
 859:             {LookupEntity}Id = _filters.{LookupEntity}Id,
 860:         };
 861: 
 862:         _filtered{Entities} = await Mediator.Send(request);
 863:     }
 864: 
 865:     private async Task ClearAllFilters()
 866:     {
 867:         _filters = new {Entity}FilterDto();
 868:         await ApplyFilters();
 869:     }
 870: 
 871:     private void Clear{ParentEntity}()
 872:     {
 873:         _filters.{ParentEntity}Id = null;
 874:     }
 875: }
 876: ```
 877: 
 878: ---
 879: 
 880: ## 8. Infinite Scroll Pattern
 881: 
 882: Loads more data as the user scrolls to the bottom of a list, improving performance for very long lists.
 883: 
 884: ```razor
 885: @inject IJSRuntime JS
 886: 
 887: <div @ref="_scrollContainer" style="height: 600px; overflow-y: auto;">
 888:     <MudGrid>
 889:         @foreach (var item in _{entities})
 890:         {
 891:             <MudItem xs="12" md="6" lg="4">
 892:                 <{Entity}Card {Entity}="@item" />
 893:             </MudItem>
 894:         }
 895:     </MudGrid>
 896: 
 897:     @if (_hasMore)
 898:     {
 899:         <div @ref="_loadMoreTrigger" class="d-flex justify-center py-4">
 900:             <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Color="Color.Primary" />
 901:             <MudText Class="ml-2">Loading more...</MudText>
 902:         </div>
 903:     }
 904:     else if (_{entities}.Any())
 905:     {
 906:         <div class="d-flex justify-center py-4">
 907:             <MudText Color="Color.Secondary">No more {entities} to load.</MudText>
 908:         </div>
 909:     }
 910: </div>
 911: 
 912: @code {
 913:     private ElementReference _scrollContainer;
 914:     private ElementReference _loadMoreTrigger;
 915:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> _{entities} = new();
 916:     private int _currentPage = 1;
 917:     private bool _hasMore = true;
 918:     private bool _isLoading = false;
 919: 
 920:     protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
 921:     {
 922:         if (firstRender)
 923:         {
 924:             await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("app.registerIntersectionObserver", _loadMoreTrigger, DotNetObjectReference.Create(this), nameof(LoadMore));
 925:             await LoadMore{Entities}();
 926:         }
 927:     }
 928: 
 929:     [JSInvokable]
 930:     public async Task LoadMore()
 931:     {
 932:         if (_isLoading || !_hasMore) return;
 933: 
 934:         _isLoading = true;
 935:         _currentPage++;
 936: 
 937:         await LoadMore{Entities}();
 938: 
 939:         _isLoading = false;
 940:         StateHasChanged();
 941:     }
 942: 
 943:     private async Task LoadMore{Entities}()
 944:     {
 945:         var request = new Get{Entity}ListRequest
 946:         {
 947:             Page = _currentPage,
 948:             PageSize = 12
 949:         };
 950: 
 951:         var result = await Mediator.Send(request);
 952: 
 953:         if (result?.{Entities} != null && result.{Entities}.Any())
 954:         {
 955:             _{entities}.AddRange(result.{Entities});
 956:             _hasMore = result.HasMore;
 957:         }
 958:         else
 959:         {
 960:             _hasMore = false;
 961:         }
 962:     }
 963: 
 964:     public void Dispose()
 965:     {
 966:         JS.InvokeVoidAsync("app.disposeIntersectionObserver", _loadMoreTrigger);
 967:     }
 968: }
 969: ```
 970: 
 971: **`wwwroot/js/site.js` (for Intersection Observer)**:
 972: ```javascript
 973: window.app = {
 974:     _intersectionObservers: new Map(),
 975: 
 976:     registerIntersectionObserver: (element, dotnetHelper, methodName) => {
 977:         if (!element) {
 978:             console.warn("Intersection Observer: Element not found.");
 979:             return;
 980:         }
 981: 
 982:         const options = {
 983:             root: element.parentElement,
 984:             rootMargin: '0px',
 985:             threshold: 0.1
 986:         };
 987: 
 988:         const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
 989:             entries.forEach(entry => {
 990:                 if (entry.isIntersecting) {
 991:                     dotnetHelper.invokeMethodAsync(methodName);
 992:                 }
 993:             });
 994:         }, options);
 995: 
 996:         observer.observe(element);
 997:         app._intersectionObservers.set(element, observer);
 998:     },
 999: 
1000:     disposeIntersectionObserver: (element) => {
1001:         if (app._intersectionObservers.has(element)) {
1002:             const observer = app._intersectionObservers.get(element);
1003:             observer.unobserve(element);
1004:             observer.disconnect();
1005:             app._intersectionObservers.delete(element);
1006:         }
1007:     }
1008: };
1009: ```
1010: 
1011: ---
1012: 
1013: ## 9. Pagination Patterns
1014: 
1015: Client-side pagination using `MudPagination` for filtered data with page info display.
1016: 
1017: ### Client-Side Pagination with MudPagination
1018: 
1019: ```razor
1020: <MudContainer>
1021:     <!-- Filters Section -->
1022:     <div class="filters mb-4">
1023:         <MudTextField @bind-Value="searchText"
1024:                       Placeholder="Search"
1025:                       Immediate="true"
1026:                       DebounceInterval="500"
1027:                       TextChanged="OnSearch" />
1028:     </div>
1029: 
1030:     <!-- Data Grid -->
1031:     <MudGrid>
1032:         @if (isLoading)
1033:         {
1034:             @for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
1035:             {
1036:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4">
1037:                     <MudSkeleton SkeletonType="SkeletonType.Rectangle" Height="200px" />
1038:                 </MudItem>
1039:             }
1040:         }
1041:         else if (!Filtered{Entities}.Any())
1042:         {
1043:             <MudItem xs="12" Class="d-flex justify-center align-center pa-8">
1044:                 <div class="text-center">
1045:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.SearchOff" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Secondary" />
1046:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Color="Color.Secondary">No {entities} found</MudText>
1047:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-2">
1048:                         Try adjusting your filters or search query
1049:                     </MudText>
1050:                 </div>
1051:             </MudItem>
1052:         }
1053:         else
1054:         {
1055:             @foreach (var item in Filtered{Entities})
1056:             {
1057:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4">
1058:                     <{Entity}Card {Entity}="@item" />
1059:                 </MudItem>
1060:             }
1061:         }
1062:     </MudGrid>
1063: 
1064:     <!-- Pagination Controls -->
1065:     <div class="pagination-wrapper d-flex justify-center mt-4">
1066:         <MudPagination Count="@TotalPages"
1067:                        Selected="@currentPage"
1068:                        SelectedChanged="@((int page) => OnPageChanged(page))"
1069:                        Color="Color.Primary"
1070:                        ShowFirstButton="true"
1071:                        ShowLastButton="true" />
1072:     </div>
1073: 
1074:     <!-- Results Info -->
1075:     <div class="results-info d-flex justify-center mt-2">
1076:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Surface">
1077:             Showing @((currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage + 1) - @(Math.Min(currentPage * itemsPerPage, AllFiltered{Entities}.Count)) of @AllFiltered{Entities}.Count {entities} (Page @currentPage of @TotalPages)
1078:         </MudText>
1079:     </div>
1080: </MudContainer>
1081: 
1082: @code {
1083:     private int currentPage = 1;
1084:     private int itemsPerPage = 6;
1085:     private string searchText = "";
1086:     private {IdType}? selectedCategoryId;
1087:     private bool isLoading = true;
1088:     private ICollection<{Entity}ListDto> all{Entities} = new List<{Entity}ListDto>();
1089: 
1090:     /// <summary>
1091:     /// All {entities} after applying filters (before pagination).
1092:     /// </summary>
1093:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> AllFiltered{Entities}
1094:     {
1095:         get
1096:         {
1097:             var filtered{Entities} = all{Entities}.AsEnumerable();
1098: 
1099:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchText))
1100:             {
1101:                 filtered{Entities} = filtered{Entities}.Where(e =>
1102:                     e.Title.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1103:                     (e.Description?.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false));
1104:             }
1105: 
1106:             if (selectedCategoryId.HasValue)
1107:             {
1108:                 filtered{Entities} = filtered{Entities}.Where(e => e.CategoryId == selectedCategoryId.Value);
1109:             }
1110: 
1111:             return filtered{Entities}.ToList();
1112:         }
1113:     }
1114: 
1115:     /// <summary>
1116:     /// Paginated subset of filtered {entities} for current page display.
1117:     /// </summary>
1118:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> Filtered{Entities}
1119:     {
1120:         get
1121:         {
1122:             return AllFiltered{Entities}
1123:                 .Skip((currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage)
1124:                 .Take(itemsPerPage)
1125:                 .ToList();
1126:         }
1127:     }
1128: 
1129:     private int TotalPages
1130:     {
1131:         get
1132:         {
1133:             var count = AllFiltered{Entities}.Count;
1134:             return count > 0 ? (int)Math.Ceiling((double)count / itemsPerPage) : 1;
1135:         }
1136:     }
1137: 
1138:     private void OnPageChanged(int page)
1139:     {
1140:         currentPage = page;
1141:     }
1142: 
1143:     /// <summary>
1144:     /// CRITICAL: Always reset currentPage = 1 when any filter changes.
1145:     /// </summary>
1146:     private void OnSearch(string value)
1147:     {
1148:         searchText = value;
1149:         currentPage = 1; // ✅ Reset pagination on filter change
1150:     }
1151: 
1152:     private void OnCategoryChanged({IdType}? categoryId)
1153:     {
1154:         selectedCategoryId = categoryId;
1155:         currentPage = 1; // ✅ Reset pagination on filter change
1156:     }
1157: }
1158: ```
1159: 
1160: ### Key Pagination Patterns
1161: 
1162: | Pattern | Description |
1163: |---------|-------------|
1164: | `AllFiltered{Entities}` | Property that applies all filters but NO pagination |
1165: | `Filtered{Entities}` | Property that applies Skip/Take for current page |
1166: | `TotalPages` | Computed from `AllFiltered{Entities}.Count / itemsPerPage` |
1167: | `currentPage = 1` | **Always reset** when any filter changes |
1168: 
1169: ### MudPagination Component Properties
1170: 
1171: ```razor
1172: <MudPagination
1173:     Count="@TotalPages"               @* Total number of pages *@
1174:     Selected="@currentPage"           @* Current selected page (1-indexed) *@
1175:     SelectedChanged="OnPageChanged"   @* Event callback when page changes *@
1176:     Color="Color.Primary"             @* Button color *@
1177:     ShowFirstButton="true"            @* Show |< button *@
1178:     ShowLastButton="true"             @* Show >| button *@
1179:     ShowPreviousButton="true"         @* Show < button (default true) *@
1180:     ShowNextButton="true"             @* Show > button (default true) *@
1181:     BoundaryCount="1"                 @* Pages shown at start/end *@
1182:     MiddleCount="3"                   @* Pages shown around current *@
1183: />
1184: ```
1185: 
1186: ### Results Info Pattern
1187: 
1188: Always show pagination context to users:
1189: 
1190: ```razor
1191: <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
1192:     Showing @StartItem - @EndItem of @TotalItems results
1193: </MudText>
1194: 
1195: @code {
1196:     private int StartItem => (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage + 1;
1197:     private int EndItem => Math.Min(currentPage * itemsPerPage, AllFiltered{Entities}.Count);
1198:     private int TotalItems => AllFiltered{Entities}.Count;
1199: }
1200: ```
1201: 
1202: ### Server-Side Pagination (Alternative)
1203: 
1204: For large datasets, use server-side pagination with `PaginatedResult<T>`:
1205: 
1206: ```razor
1207: @code {
1208:     private PaginatedResult<{Entity}ListDto>? _pagedResult;
1209:     private int _currentPage = 1;
1210:     private int _pageSize = 20;
1211: 
1212:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
1213:     {
1214:         await LoadPageAsync(_currentPage);
1215:     }
1216: 
1217:     private async Task LoadPageAsync(int page)
1218:     {
1219:         isLoading = true;
1220:         try
1221:         {
1222:             _pagedResult = await {Entity}Service.Get{Entities}PagedAsync(page, _pageSize);
1223:             _currentPage = page;
1224:         }
1225:         finally
1226:         {
1227:             isLoading = false;
1228:         }
1229:     }
1230: 
1231:     private async Task OnPageChanged(int page)
1232:     {
1233:         await LoadPageAsync(page);
1234:     }
1235: 
1236:     private int TotalPages => _pagedResult?.TotalPages ?? 1;
1237:     private IEnumerable<{Entity}ListDto> Items => _pagedResult?.Items ?? Enumerable.Empty<{Entity}ListDto>();
1238: }
1239: ```
1240: 
1241: ---
1242: 
1243: **Related Resources**:
1244: - [component-design.md](component-design.md) - Component lifecycle and communication.
1245: - [mudblazor-usage.md](mudblazor-usage.md) - Specific MudBlazor component usage.
1246: - [state-management.md](state-management.md) - How to manage state for these patterns.

## File: .claude/skills/blazor-ui-conventions/resources/component-design.md
````markdown
  1: # Component Design - Structure, Lifecycle, and Communication
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Blazor Component Patterns**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: This document outlines best practices for designing and structuring Blazor components, covering component anatomy, lifecycle, parameters, `EventCallback` for communication, and the code-behind pattern.
  8: 
  9: ---
 10: 
 11: ## 1. Blazor Component Anatomy
 12: 
 13: Blazor components are primarily defined in `.razor` files, which combine HTML markup with C# code. You can choose between a single-file approach or a code-behind approach.
 14: 
 15: ### Single-File Component (.razor)
 16: 
 17: Convenient for simpler components or prototyping where C# logic is minimal.
 18: 
 19: ```razor
 20: @page "/{entities}" @* Makes this component routable *@
 21: @using MudBlazor @* Common using directives *@
 22: @inject IMediator Mediator @* Inject dependencies *@
 23: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 24: 
 25: <PageTitle>{Entities} List</PageTitle> @* Sets browser tab title *@
 26: 
 27: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large">
 28:     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4">@Title</MudText> @* Access C# properties in markup *@
 29: 
 30:     @if (_isLoading)
 31:     {
 32:         <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" />
 33:     }
 34:     else
 35:     {
 36:         <MudButton OnClick="Load{Entities}">Refresh {Entities}</MudButton> @* Event handler *@
 37:     }
 38: </MudContainer>
 39: 
 40: @code { @* C# code block *@
 41:     private string Title { get; set; } = "{Entity} List";
 42:     private bool _isLoading;
 43: 
 44:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() @* Lifecycle method *@
 45:     {
 46:         _isLoading = true;
 47:         await Load{Entities}();
 48:         _isLoading = false;
 49:     }
 50: 
 51:     private async Task Load{Entities}()
 52:     {
 53:         // Logic to load {entity} data
 54:         // _{entities} = await Mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}ListRequest());
 55:     }
 56: }
 57: ```
 58: 
 59: ### Code-Behind Pattern (.razor + .razor.cs)
 60: 
 61: Recommended for more complex components, pages, or when separating UI from logic improves readability and testability.
 62: 
 63: **`{Entity}List.razor`**:
 64: ```razor
 65: @page "/{entities}"
 66: @using MudBlazor
 67: @inherits {Entity}ListBase @* Inherit from the code-behind class *@
 68: 
 69: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large">
 70:     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4">@Title</MudText>
 71:     <MudButton OnClick="Load{Entities}">Refresh {Entities}</MudButton>
 72: </MudContainer>
 73: ```
 74: 
 75: **`{Entity}List.razor.cs`**:
 76: ```csharp
 77: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components; // Base component functionality
 78: using MediatR; // Example dependency
 79: using MudBlazor; // Example dependency
 80: 
 81: namespace {Project}.Blazor.Components.Pages; // Namespace matching component location
 82: 
 83: // The code-behind class must inherit from ComponentBase or another base class
 84: public partial class {Entity}ListBase : ComponentBase
 85: {
 86:     // Injected properties are available in markup and code-behind
 87:     [Inject] protected IMediator Mediator { get; set; } = null!;
 88:     [Inject] protected ISnackbar Snackbar { get; set; } = null!;
 89: 
 90:     // Protected properties are accessible from the .razor file
 91:     protected string Title { get; set; } = "{Entity} List";
 92: 
 93:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 94:     {
 95:         // Initialization logic
 96:         await Load{Entities}();
 97:     }
 98: 
 99:     protected async Task Load{Entities}()
100:     {
101:         // Data loading logic
102:     }
103: }
104: ```
105: 
106: ### When to Use Each Pattern:
107: 
108: *   **Single-file**: Use for simple, self-contained UI elements, prototyping, or small components where the C# logic is minimal.
109: *   **Code-behind**: Prefer for complex components, pages, or any component where the C# logic is substantial and separating it from the UI markup enhances clarity, testability, or maintainability.
110: 
111: ---
112: 
113: ## 2. Component Lifecycle
114: 
115: Understanding the Blazor component lifecycle is crucial for performing operations at the correct time (e.g., data fetching, JavaScript interop, resource cleanup).
116: 
117: ```mermaid
118: graph TD
119:     A[Constructor] --> B[SetParametersAsync]
120:     B --> C{firstRender?}
121:     C -- Yes --> D[OnInitialized / OnInitializedAsync]
122:     D --> E[OnParametersSet / OnParametersSetAsync]
123:     E --> F[BuildRenderTree]
124:     F --> G[OnAfterRender / OnAfterRenderAsync (firstRender: true)]
125:     G --> H{Parameter changed / StateHasChanged called?}
126:     H -- Yes --> E
127:     H -- No --> I[Waiting for events...]
128:     I --> H
129:     G --> J[OnAfterRender / OnAfterRenderAsync (firstRender: false)]
130:     J --> H
131:     H -- Component Removed --> K[Dispose]
132: 
133:     subgraph Notes
134:         D_Note[Data fetching here]
135:         G_Note[JS interop here]
136:         K_Note[Resource cleanup]
137:     end
138: 
139:     D --- D_Note
140:     G --- G_Note
141:     K --- K_Note
142: ```
143: 
144: ### Key Lifecycle Methods and Their Use Cases:
145: 
146: #### `OnInitializedAsync` - Initial Data Loading
147: 
148: Use this method to fetch initial data for the component. It's called only **once** when the component is first initialized.
149: 
150: ```csharp
151: @code {
152:     private List<{Entity}ListDto>? _{entities};
153:     private bool _isLoading = true;
154: 
155:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
156:     {
157:         _isLoading = true;
158:         try
159:         {
160:             var request = new Get{Entity}ListRequest();
161:             _{entities} = await Mediator.Send(request); // Fetch data from API/service
162:         }
163:         finally
164:         {
165:             _isLoading = false;
166:         }
167:     }
168: }
169: ```
170: 
171: #### `OnParametersSetAsync` - Reacting to Parameter Changes
172: 
173: This method is called every time parameters supplied by the parent component change, and also after `OnInitializedAsync` on the first render. Use it to react to new parameter values.
174: 
175: ```csharp
176: @code {
177:     [Parameter]
178:     public {IdType} {ParentEntity}Id { get; set; }
179: 
180:     private List<{Entity}ListDto>? _{entities};
181:     private {IdType} _current{ParentEntity}Id; // Track previous parameter value
182: 
183:     protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
184:     {
185:         // Only reload data if {ParentEntity}Id has actually changed
186:         if ({ParentEntity}Id != _current{ParentEntity}Id && {ParentEntity}Id != default)
187:         {
188:             _current{ParentEntity}Id = {ParentEntity}Id; // Update tracking variable
189:             var request = new Get{Entity}ListRequest { {ParentEntity}Id = {ParentEntity}Id };
190:             _{entities} = await Mediator.Send(request);
191:         }
192:     }
193: }
194: ```
195: 
196: #### `OnAfterRenderAsync` - JavaScript Interop and DOM Access
197: 
198: Use this method for tasks that require the component's HTML to be rendered in the DOM, such as initializing JavaScript libraries or accessing DOM elements. It is called twice: once after the component's first render (`firstRender = true`), and then after every subsequent re-render (`firstRender = false`).
199: 
200: ```csharp
201: @inject IJSRuntime JS
202: 
203: @code {
204:     private ElementReference _mapElement; // Reference to a DOM element
205: 
206:     protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
207:     {
208:         if (firstRender)
209:         {
210:             // Initialize JavaScript libraries or interact with the DOM here
211:             await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("initializeMap", _mapElement);
212:         }
213:     }
214: }
215: ```
216: 
217: #### `IDisposable` - Resource Cleanup
218: 
219: Implement `IDisposable` to release resources when the component is removed from the UI (e.g., unsubscribe from events, dispose timers).
220: 
221: ```csharp
222: @implements IDisposable
223: 
224: @code {
225:     private System.Timers.Timer? _timer;
226: 
227:     protected override void OnInitialized()
228:     {
229:         _timer = new System.Timers.Timer(1000);
230:         _timer.Elapsed += (sender, e) => InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged); // Update UI on timer tick
231:         _timer.Start();
232:     }
233: 
234:     public void Dispose()
235:     {
236:         // Clean up resources to prevent memory leaks
237:         _timer?.Dispose();
238:         _timer = null;
239:     }
240: }
241: ```
242: 
243: ---
244: 
245: ## 3. Parameters - Parent to Child Communication
246: 
247: Parameters are the primary mechanism for passing data from a parent component to its direct child component.
248: 
249: ### Declaring Parameters
250: 
251: Use the `[Parameter]` attribute on public properties with `get; set;`.
252: 
253: ```csharp
254: @code {
255:     [Parameter]
256:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty; // Good practice to provide a default value
257: 
258:     [Parameter]
259:     public {Entity}Dto {Entity} { get; set; } = null!; // Use null-forgiving operator for required complex objects
260: 
261:     [Parameter]
262:     public int? MaxItems { get; set; } // Use nullable types for optional parameters
263: }
264: ```
265: 
266: ### Parameter Validation
267: 
268: It's good practice to validate critical parameters in `OnParametersSet` or `OnParametersSetAsync`.
269: 
270: ```csharp
271: @code {
272:     [Parameter]
273:     public {IdType} {Entity}Id { get; set; }
274: 
275:     protected override void OnParametersSet()
276:     {
277:         if ({Entity}Id == default)
278:         {
279:             throw new ArgumentException("{Entity}Id parameter cannot be an empty value.", nameof({Entity}Id));
280:         }
281:     }
282: }
283: ```
284: 
285: ### Parameter Best Practices:
286: 
287: *   **DO: Store Parameter in Private Field for Local Modification**: If a parameter needs to be modified locally within the child component, copy its value to a private field first.
288: 
289:     ```csharp
290:     @code {
291:         [Parameter]
292:         public bool Expanded { get; set; } // Parent controls initial state
293: 
294:         private bool _isExpanded; // Local state for internal use
295: 
296:         protected override void OnParametersSet()
297:         {
298:             _isExpanded = Expanded; // Copy parameter value to local field
299:         }
300: 
301:         private void Toggle()
302:         {
303:             _isExpanded = !_isExpanded; // Modify local state
304:             // If the parent needs to know about this change, use EventCallback
305:         }
306:     }
307:     ```
308: 
309: *   **DON'T: Modify Parameter Directly**: Parameters are typically read-only from the child's perspective. Modifying them directly will often be overwritten on the next render cycle by the parent's value, or lead to unexpected behavior.
310: 
311:     ```csharp
312:     @code {
313:         [Parameter]
314:         public bool Expanded { get; set; }
315: 
316:         private void Toggle()
317:         {
318:             Expanded = !Expanded; // This change might be overwritten by the parent
319:         }
320:     }
321:     ```
322: 
323: ---
324: 
325: ## 4. EventCallback - Child to Parent Communication
326: 
327: `EventCallback<T>` is the standard way for child components to notify their parent components of events or changes.
328: 
329: ### Basic EventCallback
330: 
331: **Parent Component (`{Entity}List.razor`)**:
332: ```razor
333: <{Entity}Card {Entity}="@selected{Entity}" OnDelete="HandleDelete" />
334: 
335: @code {
336:     private {Entity}Dto? selected{Entity};
337: 
338:     private async Task HandleDelete({IdType} {entity}Id) // Method in parent to handle the event
339:     {
340:         // Perform deletion logic
341:         Snackbar.Add($"{Entity} {{entity}Id} deleted", Severity.Success);
342:     }
343: }
344: ```
345: 
346: **Child Component (`{Entity}Card.razor`)**:
347: ```razor
348: <MudCard>
349:     <MudCardActions>
350:         <MudButton Color="Color.Error" OnClick="DeleteClicked">Delete</MudButton>
351:     </MudCardActions>
352: </MudCard>
353: 
354: @code {
355:     [Parameter]
356:     public {Entity}Dto {Entity} { get; set; } = null!;
357:
