## File: Explore.Persistence/Repositories/OrganizationRepository.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Collections.Generic;
 3: using System.Text;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using Explore.Domain;
 6: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 7: 
 8: namespace Explore.Persistence.Repositories
 9: {
10:     public class OrganizationRepository : GenericRepository<Organization, Guid>, IOrganizationRepository
11:     {
12:         private readonly ExploreDbContext _dbContext;
13: 
14:         public OrganizationRepository(ExploreDbContext dbContext) : base(dbContext)
15:         {
16:             _dbContext = dbContext;
17:         }
18: 
19:         public async Task<List<Organization>> GetOrganizationsWithDetails()
20:         {
21:             return await _dbContext.Organizations
22:                 .Include(o => o.ApprovalStatus)
23:                 .Include(o => o.Actor)
24:                     .ThenInclude(a => a!.ProfilePicture)
25:                 .Include(o => o.Tenant)
26:                 .ToListAsync();
27:         }
28: 
29:         public async Task<Organization?> GetOrganizationWithDetails(Guid id)
30:         {
31:             return await _dbContext.Organizations
32:                 .Include(o => o.ApprovalStatus)
33:                 .Include(o => o.Actor)
34:                     .ThenInclude(a => a!.ProfilePicture)
35:                 .Include(o => o.Tenant)
36:                 .Include(o => o.Members)
37:                     .ThenInclude(m => m.User)
38:                 .Include(o => o.Members)
39:                     .ThenInclude(m => m.OrganizationRole)
40:                 .Include(o => o.Members)
41:                     .ThenInclude(m => m.OrganizationPosition)
42:                 .FirstOrDefaultAsync(o => o.Id == id);
43:         }
44: 
45:         public async Task<List<Organization>> GetMyOrganizations(Guid userId)
46:         {
47:             return await _dbContext.Organizations
48:                 .Include(o => o.ApprovalStatus)
49:                 .Include(o => o.Actor)
50:                     .ThenInclude(a => a!.ProfilePicture)
51:                 .Include(o => o.Members)
52:                     .ThenInclude(m => m.OrganizationRole)
53:                 .Where(o => o.Members.Any(m => m.UserId == userId))
54:                 .ToListAsync();
55:         }
56: 
57:         public async Task<(List<Organization> Items, int TotalCount)> GetOrganizationsWithDetailsPaged(int pageNumber, int pageSize)
58:         {
59:             var query = _dbContext.Organizations
60:                 .AsNoTracking()
61:                 .Include(o => o.ApprovalStatus)
62:                 .Include(o => o.Actor)
63:                     .ThenInclude(a => a!.ProfilePicture)
64:                 .Include(o => o.Tenant)
65:                 .OrderBy(o => o.FullName);
66: 
67:             var totalCount = await query.CountAsync();
68:             var items = await query
69:                 .Skip((pageNumber - 1) * pageSize)
70:                 .Take(pageSize)
71:                 .ToListAsync();
72: 
73:             return (items, totalCount);
74:         }
75: 
76:         public async Task<(List<Organization> Items, int TotalCount)> GetMyOrganizationsPaged(Guid userId, int pageNumber, int pageSize)
77:         {
78:             var query = _dbContext.Organizations
79:                 .AsNoTracking()
80:                 .Include(o => o.ApprovalStatus)
81:                 .Include(o => o.Actor)
82:                     .ThenInclude(a => a!.ProfilePicture)
83:                 .Include(o => o.Members)
84:                     .ThenInclude(m => m.OrganizationRole)
85:                 .Where(o => o.Members.Any(m => m.UserId == userId))
86:                 .OrderBy(o => o.FullName);
87: 
88:             var totalCount = await query.CountAsync();
89:             var items = await query
90:                 .Skip((pageNumber - 1) * pageSize)
91:                 .Take(pageSize)
92:                 .ToListAsync();
93: 
94:             return (items, totalCount);
95:         }
96:     }
97: }
````

````csharp
560:         {
561:             var aspects = new List<string>();
562:             if (src.IslamicAspect != null) aspects.Add("Islamic");
563:             if (src.TechAspect != null) aspects.Add("Tech");
564:             return aspects;
````
